Hawwa: Šennoo ga hima ka harand’i še hunday
Kayna kul Isufi huro ka kaa. Waatoo kaŋ i na cere foo ka ben
Hawwa: Ay-izoo, woyoo kaŋ agay nda ni ɲaa n’a jisi ma ne goo ne. Hiijaa ma tee tanba ya. Arey goo n’i ga kay a še.
Maryama: Kadiija kaŋ da no ma kay ni jine
Isufi: Zanka woyey kaŋ mana koy lokkol š’a ra. Koyne, ya na too hiijay mo. Boro kul maši ne nga ga goro k’ay batu
Hawwa: Macin Isufi? N’ši baa haw agay. Ayyo n’ne ni waymaa kaŋ a mana koy lokkol še n’ga wanga
Maryama: N’ši yadda. Hala de n’ga baa ya gaara ma ne de ma hiiji Kadiija
Isufi: Cimoo de n’ay na har war še (a tun a fatta, Kadiija g’a guna de)
Maryama : A mma hooray. A ši yadda. Borey de gamey r’a ga woo har
Batu hinzantoo : Isufi baabey nda ɲaŋey margaa nga hiijaa fondaa ra
Alaasar jingaroo bandaa ga, batoo goro

Seydu: Baani š’ay na war cee. Isufi woo da kaŋ kaa biifo hiijaa šennoo n’ay ga b’ir m’a tee. Hõ zanka, boro š’a naŋ nda nga boŋ, nda man’ti woo din, i ga hanga hooraa bande, kal’i ma žen i ši hiiji. Hawwa, Womoru, macin no war ne šennoo woo ra?

Hawwa: Agay hunday war kul ga bay kaŋ za jiiroo kaŋ kadiija ay wanoo hayandi, nga r’ay na kayandi Isufi še. Hõ kaŋ, Irko n’ir boŋey kaanandi, a caw ka ben, haya kul ši no kal’a ma kaa kaŋ nga wandoo zaa. Subbaahi kul arey mma koy i ga kaa. Ay ga n’i še kaŋ allaahidu no kaŋ ay n’a z’ay jindoo ga, kaŋ han kaŋ ay ga huna, Isufi š’ay na Kadiija jisi
Womoru: Cimi ti woo kaŋ Seydu ay kaynoo na har. Isufi ga hima ka hiiji. Agay hunday boŋ tenjoo ra, Išata ay wanoo, hala d’a ga bag‘a, kul a g’a še taray kaaraa ra, kaatibi ay š‘a hãa nd‘a
Adullaahi: War binde, hala war ga n’ay ne woo, ay ne woo, war n’Isufi hãa binde nda haya kaŋ g’a do. Hõ zank‘arey boro maši hanse ka ni boŋ fur i ga, i maši koy mookayandi boro ga
Doobo : Alfaga Adullaahi ga cum. War m’a bay kaŋ lokkol-ize no. Ngi lakkaley nd’ir waney man’ti affoo
Seydu: Woo da no n’ne Doobo
Womoru: Sohõ, wa naŋ ir ma ciy’a š’a ma kaa, hal’ir ma hãa
Seydu: Tanti, Tanti, ciya Isufi še. N’ne a š’ay n’a ma kaa
Waatoo kaŋ Isufi kaa, a goro, borey cind’i ga cere guna

Adullaahi: Ay izoo, nd’ay tubaa cere ra, baani de š’ir na ni cee. Woy kul kurɲoo nga m’a daŋ alžanna. Nd’a yadda kurɲoo wanoo ga d’a ga huro alžanna. Amma iz’aru, ɲaŋoo nda baaboo no m’a daŋ alžanna. Ni mma yadda ngey wanoo ga, m’i hãa, m’i kula, hal’i ma buu. Woo ra n’alžannaa ga henen. šenney wey, man’ti agay k’i har, Irkoy ka ne, a goo Alkuraanaa ra.
Womoru: Hansa ka haŋajer šenney wey še kaŋ alfaga Adullaahi g’i har
Adullaahi: Hõ zaaroo, Zeydu nda Maryama ti borey, kaŋ nda n’yadda ngi wanoo ga de, n’alažannaa henen
Isufi: Ay ga maa, wa šeleŋ de
Womoru : Sohõ, ay ga šennoo dungurandi, ir mma baa ma hiiji. Ni waymey goo ne, ma gun’i ra woo kaŋ nga bag’a
Adullaahi : Hõ, n’caw ka ben, haya kul mana cindi kala ma hiiji
Doobo: Zanka mma hiiji za kuri g’a ra, za sahã g’a ra.

Isufi: Ah! War kat’ay ga šenni kaŋ ya na faham a še. Ay caw ka ben cimi no, ya na duu goy jina, taka foo nda war ga ne ya hiiji. Woyoo kaŋ war ga ne ya hiij’a, taka foo nd’ay g’a huna. Agay hunday anniyaa ti, ya mma yee Bamako, ka koy goy wiri.

Seydu: Kala-kala. Ni mma hiiji jina. Ši goy kala boŋfutay. Goyoo kaŋ n’g’a har, han foo r’a ga duwandi. Ni kon’a goo. Ni mma bay han kaŋ a ga duwandi. Maali ra hõ, ni cine marje ka caw ka ben, kaŋyaŋ goo ne, i ši baafo ra, kal’i ga goro yaada
Adullaahi: Irko no ma boro huna, boro ši ni boŋ huna
Womoru: Ni kay de ma yadda hiijaa ga. Ir ga hin ka nga hunaa zaa hala nga duu goy
Isufi : šennoo woo mana hur’ay boŋoo ra. Wa fay nda agay, ya koy goy wiri. Hii hunyan nda bari gonguyan ši koy nda cere. Hiijay ši bisa
Seydu: Isufi woo kaŋ war ga dii a, alharam hunday no, boŋfutu no. Hiijaa woo binde ga tee, n’baa mana baa, a ga tee
Adullaahi: Astafurullah, n’nee astafurullah Seydu, maši hanga albiliiši bande
Womoru: Koy ka tun ir boŋ, Seydu ga cum. N’ši dii kaŋ ir mma šeleŋ nga mo ga šeleŋ

Seydu: Sanda agay hunday, hala d’a mana yadda hiijaa woo ga, kul ay g’a harram. Ay ga bay kaŋ woo kul mana hun kala ɲamŋoo ra. Woo, ay goro nd’a. Z’ay ga dii nga nd’a ga doo, i ga ziji, ay ga bay kaŋ woo dabaroo r’i goo. Za hanoo de kaŋ ay hiiji Maryama nga ra adduɲaa takaa kul hasar’ay ga. Zaaroo de kaŋ a hur’ay kone nga r’ay hundoo mana yee ka yay ay boŋoo ra.
Adullaahi: Laali ibiliiši Seydu, laali ibiliiši

Maryama: De Ganda agay woo da. N’tunandi n’bay. Šenni kaŋ ma tee borey kul gamey ra ne, nga no n’g’a bere ka ne kaŋ agay no ma Isufi ganj’a ma hiiji. Hee Baara nda Garguna wa kaa ka maa hõ. Agay woo da kaŋ mana koy, ya na yee, nga ti boraa kaŋ ga Isufi ganj’a ma hiiji.

Hawwa: Ganda woo da, z’Irkoy n’ay tee, ya na dii nga cine. Futay nda bine-konnay ši haya kul hanse. Šenni-ize kaccu, a mma tun a hew daŋ a ra, a m’a tee haya beeri foo. Maryama woo da, ni mma baa de n’ga kaŋ a ga. Kayna-kayna kul, ay ga bay de filaana no. Haya kaŋ tee kul ay ga bay de filaana no
Womoru: šennoo woo Seydu ši tun k’a har yaada. Haya da n’a dii a. Ni nda Maryama kul affoo
Doobo: Ay izoo, ma ši yadda woo ma goy ni ga. Gaabandi, ma yadda ni baaba dabaroo ga. Maši haya tee kaŋ ga ni ɲaa nda ni baaba fayandi. Ni baaba kaŋ no, n’g’a bay kaŋ, amma haya kaccu t’i beeri foo
Isufi : Cimoo de n’ay na har war še. Taka foo nd’ay šii goy ra, i ga kaa ka huru ya ne hiijay šenni ra. Woo hunday boŋ ga, nd’a g’ay harram, a g’ay harram. Ay ši hin ka huro hiijaa woo ra
Seydu: Macin. Ayyo cimi no n’g’a har ir še. Man’ti war ga maa, war kaŋ ga ne ya ši šeleŋ. (a tarbasu ka tun, a na taami foo k’a warra, Isufi nda ɲaŋoo zur’i fatta, a ne nga ga hang’i bande)
Adullaahi: (a na Seydu dii) Kala-kala ay baase, maši woo tee, karari da ka š’a ra
Seydu: Alharamoo, hõ no n’ga waa. Ay naŋ, ay naŋ Adullaahi. Gun’ay ši baa takaa woo, Irko še hun ay jine
Doobo: Wa fay nda, a ma kaba daŋ a ra. Zankaa woo moɲoo hunday no ma kogu. War nka ši maa šenni funbey kaŋ a g’i har
Hawwa: Uhũn! N’tunandi ni mo, albiliiši
Doobo: Guna, ni mee funbaa daab’ay ga

Adullaahi: Dangay ni hine Hawwa, ay izoo nda ɲaŋoo hunday ši karandi šenni-ize yaada ga. Agay hunday daahiran kaŋ Seydu hunday bara no sohõ a ga hiijaa hasara. Ir goo šenni ra, šennoo mana ben, n’ga sar ka tun, n’ga mee ɲama, n’ga kara, ma ne ni nka maa kaŋ firaawuuna ti ni
Womoru: Sohõ, hayaa kaŋ agay hunday ga dii a, nga t’ir ma koy jina hala borey ma duu ngey lakkaley
Hawwa: Isufi zanka no, a šii nda lakkal. Gaabi ši haya tee, ir mm’a fafagay hala Irko ma lakkaloo yeeri hiijaa še
Batu taacanto: Isufi ɲaŋey ga ngi hugoo sirriyaŋ feeri a še
Waatoo kaŋ batoo say, arey fatta kul Isufi ɲaa nda ɲaakaccaa na daŋ cere game
Maryama: N’ga maa haya kaŋ ay g’a har ma ne. Ni baababeeroo izoo Išata, haya kul maši ni ka hiij’a
Hawwa: ɲaa boryo man’a hay. Ni nka ši dii haya Kaŋ i g’a goy ni baababeeroo ga.
Maryam: Ize henna kul no woyoo din man’a hay. Ma bay ya kaŋ maši ne n’g’a zaa k’a daŋ ir kone
Maryama: Zanka ti ni. Hayayaŋ goo no kaŋ n’š’i bay. Išata ɲaa ši boori. Cijiboroyaŋ no
Isufi: Macin! Ya na bay ka maa woo še
Hawwa : Cimi no binde. Haya foo de laasaabu. N’ši dii kaŋ ni baabeeroo izewoyey, ir here boro kul ši hiij’i ra. ɲaŋooyaŋ borey, wala boro waani kaŋ š’i bay de no ma hiij’i ra
Maryama : Maši ne kul n’ga cijiboro zaa ka taŋ ir ra. I ma kay de ni baababeeroo ga kaŋ i faati ka duu a. Ni baaba hunday, ay ga bay kaŋ a ši kan a še. A ga hunbur armaa de, a ši hin ka šeleŋ
Isufi : Ay faham. Ayyo wala ngey wey takaa woo borayaŋ no. Ngi binde ga ngi boŋ tee boro henna fooyaŋ, i ga hansa ka baa boro. Ya na bay ka bay woo ga kala hõ
Hawwa: Aywa maši dii takaa din. I ši boori. N‘ši hin ka bay a ga, zama zanka ti ni
Batu guwanto o : Almaari, Isufi koy nga kuraa aru-izey faajikaaray dogoo ra
Gibba : i ga n’a še žil
Awdu : i ga n’a še Aysana
Sumaana : i ga n’a še Goržiila
Sadu : i ga n’a še Joo
Habbi : i ga n’a še Baɲɲaput
Addiini : i ga n’a še koorojaga
Isufi : i ga n’a še Baalootet
Žil: Warkay! Baalootet no ma goro ne ra. Fuuyantaa woo, han foo n’a huro koyraa woo ra. Arya Faranši borey ga saabu. Ir binde maa kaŋ annasaara woy no n’hiij’a noo din ra
Baalootet: May ka woo har ma ne. Hew, ni taari beerey wey mana hun i ra hala sohõ
Aysana: Žil, Kala mana maa haya kaŋ tee. Aroo din woyey bara n’i ga yenj’a ga. Baabey n’a noo woy fiisabiirillaahi, a ne nga si bag’ey annasaarataray še, zama de nga ši goy ra
Goržiila: Irko de. Jalla! Nda agay no, woyey kaŋ i n’i cebe kul n’ay ga hiij’ey
Joo: Heehehe! tonkono ti ni
Baalootet: Wa koy de, war nka maa kaŋ takaa woo no
Koorojaga: žil, woyoo kaŋ n’nee n’ga bag’a hunday n’i n’a ceb’a še, a ne nga š’a ra
Žil: Wallaahi. Baalootet, Irko še nda n‘ši baa woyoo din, ma cimoo har, ma hun agay nda gamoo ra
Baalootet: Koy a zaa nga da no ni jine

Koorojaga: Arya Baalotet, naŋ ya ni wii haaray. Žil tun de han foo, a duu nga nooru-izeyaŋ, kul a ne Kadiija no nga ga koy a wiri. Ir n‘a gagay, ir n’a še kaŋ a ši duu a. A ne pat, ir ma koy ka hun nga boŋ. A n’ir še kaŋ nga ši kula, woyoo nga nd‘a dii cere, a ga baa nga, a ne nga ma koy wiri
Joo: De hanoo kaŋ a na nga borey samba?
Koorojaga: Woyooɲaa ne a ma koy nga kurbey heenandi bangoo ra (a wanji). Kadiija, Isufi še nga n’a jisi
Joo: A diši me ay ceroo kaŋ laaraboo jinawey ra (a perdi)
Koorojaga: Mana bay mo. Kal’a na jirbi iyye foo tee hugoo r’a ga wirci
Joo: Za waati din bind’ir n’a še kaŋ ni š’i n’a jisi. Woo binde, ay ɲaa Hawwa mana bay k’a tugu, kaŋ han kaŋ nga ga huna, boro ši hiiji Kadiija kala Isufi

Aysana: War ma bay kaŋ žil da no ma kani. Hee žil, žil tun maši koy hewkar ir boŋ. W’a tunandi a maši koy ir hungumandi. A doon’a woo, z’a šiiri ganda n’a ga tubal kar. Irko ma garsaka zankaa woo še. Agay woo kaŋ a ši baa haw
Žil: Ya na kani mo
Žil : Ay ga maa hayey kul kaŋ war g’i har. Ay ga kaba daŋ war ra, anduy. Surtu ni Aysana, aru boŋ žeena-izoo

Baɲɲapuut : Cin no m’a ganj’a ma kani. Wande hinza game r’a goo. A ši duu nga boŋ mo sok’a ma kani cijinhere. Maši dii a takaa woo, Kataaraa nka dunbu sõy a hun a ga. Šigaaroo mo mana haya kul naŋ a ra. Danduurunwaaka, n’waa ya
Baalootet : Ayyo zanka alfookoo woo wande hinza bar’a še
žil : Ni nka maa kaŋ agay ti ni, fuuyanta kaŋ, i m’a noo woy, a ma ne nga ši bag‘a
Goržiila : Annasaarawoy žeeney mana haya kul naŋ Baalootetyaŋ ra
Baalootet : Dori ma huro ni ra. Ni nka maa kaŋ agay ti ni
Baɲɲaput: Ay maa kaŋ annasaara arey ši hurobangu, woo še nda ngi woyey duu boro bibi, a ši yee ka hun i kone. Ay ceroo cimi no n’bay
Baalootet : Tuh ! n’ši baa haw n’ga šenney wey dumey har
Aysana : Ni hẽe fuyanta kaŋ woyey še n’ga zuru
žil : Guna arya, Baɲɲapuut din kaŋ n’ga dii a ga sokona ni jeroo ga, wande taaci kon’a goo
Baalootet : Heehehe ! yooboo r’a ga koy nd’ey. De taka foo nd’a g’i huna ?

Baɲɲapuut : Annasaarataray yaada. Ni nka maa kaŋ boro no ma ni boŋ huna, Irko no ma boro huna. War no kaŋ nda war jaŋ day-dayhay zaari foo, war boŋey mma kaaray bineciinay še. Ir wey han kaŋ ir duu, ir mma noo, han kaŋ ir jaŋ ir ma goro. Ir ši haw nd’a, a ši ganji mo kaŋ nd’ir duu woy mo, ir ga tonton koyne
Baalootet : Enkonšiyaŋ. Woyey wey kaŋ n’g‘i marga, n’ši hin k’i ŋaandi, n’ši hin ka zankey biir’i ma boori
Joo : Agay binde maa kaŋ woy bara Baalootet še Bamako ra, kaŋ š’a ga ne nga ši baa nga woymaa
žil : Joo ga cum. Ir maa kaŋ larbu woy-ize no, kaŋ mma caw. Woo din n’a g’a batu, nga š’a ga šiiri-šiiri borey še

Baɲɲapuut : Zankey wey kul kaŋ n’ga d’i ga šeleŋ, wande foo-foo de bar’i še, kala agay nda žil. Sohõ ir wey da ceebandey bande n‘ga hima ka hanga. Fuuyantey wey kaŋ n‘ga dii ey, man‘ti aruyaŋ no, z’almaari n‘i ga kani.
Žil: N‘ga maa haya kaŋ ay g‘a har ma ne, ni mma naŋ ir ma dabari ma ne

Baɲɲapuut: Agay woo kaŋ n‘ga dii agay, ay woyoo kaŋ agay nd’a n’allaahidu noo cere še mma bara no, kaŋ i ne ya kaa ka hiiji Arkiya. Ya na šenni kul daŋ a ra, kal’ay na ngey wanoo zaa, jin’ay kaa k’ay wanoo zaa
Žil : Ir hunday takaa woo da n’ir ga baa m’a tee. Kadiija, ni mma hiij’a, ma ni koofey ka hoy a ga jirbi hinka, ma Bamako daŋ ni jine

Baɲɲapuut: Nda n’yadda, ir ga boroyaŋ tunandi kaŋ ga koy dii ay baaba Seydu, wala šennoo ga buu. Ni nka ši hinna, guna de haya kaŋ ay baaba Seydu g’a goy woybeeroo ga, ni maaganda še. Donku, ni mma yadda hiijaa ga, woo n’ir hunday dii a ma ne
Koorojaga: Woo da ti cimoo
Joo: Arya ma bay kaŋ ma ši ne n’ga haŋajer furkey wey še
Baalootet: Fay nd’ey de, ay ši haya kul har i še
Baɲɲapuut : Maši haw ya. Ir ga ni batu ne da ra. Nda ni nka maa kaŋ ni foo ti aroo kaŋ ši hugu booba tee, bandiisalo

Jirbi woy cindi guu banda ga, Isufi kokor ka yadda borey šennoo še, a na woymaa zaa. Baabey nda ɲaŋey yee cera ga, i na hiijaa tee. Haw buu, feeji buu, hawru boobo hinandi, takanba kaana beeri tee kaŋ na borey faaji kaa, heey hiijaa hanse ka kan, koyraa kul ɲaali nda hiijaa kaŋ dumoo gay nd’a ma tee koyraa ra
Zuu hinzantoo : Isufi nda Layla Tuure hiijaa šennoo
Kadiija : Hugooɲaa no (isufi wande jina)
Faadi : Kadiija ize woyoo
Batu jinaa : Isufi hiijaa alhabaaroo
Kadiija ga hun jendoo ga kaŋ ceroo n’a kubay
Gaššo : Ay ceroo, agay nda ni ka hooray ka tun nda cere. Ya na bay ka haya kul tugu ma ne, amma ni hunday n’ga tuga ya ne
Kadiija : Hee ay ceroo, macin n’ay na tugu ma ne
Gaššo: N’ga bay far haya kaŋ no
Kadiija : Wallaahi ay ceroo, ay ši hayaa woo bay kaŋ n’g’a har. Ni kay de m’a har ya ne nda cimi no kul ay g’a har ma ne
Gaššo: Ay maa kaŋ ni arubeeroo Isufi tirafeeri larbuwoy foo ga, amma mana bay k’a har ya ne
Kadiija: (A kay ma nee karji k’a hay) May ka woo har ma ne. Agay binde mana m’a še
Gaššo : N’maar’a far, ni nka ši baa de m’a har ya ne
Kadiija : Wallaahi, tiiraa m’ay dii bala ya na m’a še. I ne may g’a tirafeeri

Gaššo: Ya na maa boraa maaɲoo, amma ay maa kaŋ lokkol-ize no kaŋ sakul a caw ka ben. I ne mo kaŋ larbu woy-ize no. šennoo woo binde, koyraa kul goo nd’a še alhabar. Agay binde biifo da kaŋ ay ga hun yooboo ra nga ra boro na har ya ne
Kadiija: Ayyo Isufi yadda k’ay zanba (kaŋ a ga woo har, kul moɲey kokooru, i kay-kay nda hari)
Gaššo: Ay ceroo m’ay sutura. Ya na bay wal’a mana m’a še. Ma ši ne Isufi še kaŋ agay k’a har ma ne
Kadiija : Hih! Hih ! Hih ! (a ga hẽe) Nda n’ti ni š’a ra, ay ši m’a še (a ga mundawey tuusu)

Gaššo: Ay ceroo maši hẽe, gaabu ni binoo ga, a ga ben. Ma kaa furoo dogoo ra alaasar. Ay ga boro bay kaŋ nd’ir koy a do, kul a ga hanse nd’Irkoy baa. Maši hẽe koyne n’ga maa. Koy ni hugoo do, ma tee sanda mana maa haya kul še
Waatoo kaŋ Kadiija too hugey do, izoo Hamma zuru k’a kubay
Hamma: Ayya man la n’hun. N’dere ir še. Macin no n’kate ir še (ɲaŋoo mana tuur’a še, a mana baa ɲeli k’a guna. A cebu tinda g’a mana bay)

Kadiija: Waatoo kaŋ a ga huro hugoo ra, a kati tintimoo ga. Taafaa feeri, a n’a dii kaboo ra. A huru nga hugoo ra. A mongu ka goro, a cindi d’a ga will’a ga bere, a ši bay haya kaŋ no nga g’a tee, izoo g’a bande
Hamma : (Izoo ga dii kaŋ a ga hẽe) Ayya cin no še n’ga hẽe? Ni nda may ka yenje ? Ay Baaba ? Hũ ? (ɲaaŋoo si tuur’a še)
Kadiija : Waatoo kaŋ lakkaloo yeekate a ga, a gaarandi ka hina izey še za ngi baaba mana kaa. I ŋaa, a ne izey še kaŋ nda ngi baaba k’i ma ši n’a še ngi ŋaa
Kayna kul Isufi huro ka kaa, Hamma zuru k’a kubay
Hamma : Ay Baaba, Ayya goo n’a ga hẽe. Ay ši bay haya kaŋ š’a ga hẽe ?
Isufi : War ga ban
Kadiija : A mana tuur’a še
Isufi : Cin no ka tee? Nda boro ka buu da, n’ga hima k’a har borey še
Kadiija : Ni mma kula boro buu wal’a huna
Isufi: (A ciya izewoyoo še) Kat’ay cirkosaa
Faadi : Ir mana hina mo
Faadi : Ay ši bay
Kadiija : N’ti ni nka zay ka koy hiiji. Koy ŋaa nonguroo kaŋ ra n’hun. Zanbanta
Isufi : Ayyo, wala woo še hew goo ni ra. Ay hiiji ya, b’a ši kan ma ne

Kadiija : Ay gay, ay dii kaŋ ni takaa barmay. Nd’ir hina n’ši ŋaa. Nda n’fatta n’ši kaa tanba. Kaaba mma mullandi de. Kayna-kayna kul n’ga buura agay nda zankey ga, n’ga ne m’ir kar yaada boŋ ga. Darbay šii, day-day hay šii, waati kul n’šii nd’a
Isufi : Guna ma bay kaŋ ma fay nda agay, nda n’ši baa ni miɲoo ma kayri

Kadiija : Nga ne ti woo, kaa k’a kayri. Woo da bara ni ra. Wallaahi bara n’ši haw, n’ga ne ni mma koy jiiraa ra, n’ga ne ni mma meehaw, da ni binde aruzaytaray ti ni goyoo. Koy ni woykuuroo do, a ma ŋaayan hina ma ne
Isufi : Borey kul ga maa n’bay. May ti ni woykuuroo ?
Kadiija : Wallaahi bara woykuuru no, ni mo arukuuru ti ni

Fiinanɓe keewal neesuuji, haalaaji e diinaaji ;
Ceyoriiɓe taariki mum’en mo duuɓi ujunaaji kaɲum e mammiraaɓe mum’en ;
Ronuɓe ndewguuji laamu mahiiɗi dow neesuuji e neɗɗaaku finaa-tawaa, ɗi baale gooduɗe e garooje ɗee fuu kaani ɲemmbude ;

Rewuɓe miijooji sa’iidi’en laamu kolon, mammiraaɓe wadduɓe laamu hewtaare e saamuɓe e boowal wolde kammari haɓanaade suudu baaba nduu, hewtugol leydi laamoraandi doygal, laamu potondiral yimɓe fuu e kammari laamu fooccingu;
Ngam masiiba yaawartaajo kuuɓuɗo nokkuule fuu so torri Leydi ndii e jamaanu oo;
Ngam yurkuyurku oo e faggitagol jawdi karmungol ngol annii bonna tinnaareeji banngal yirwingol leydi ndii;
Heɓɓe taƴoral nafaa yirwingol baaldal e dewrital leydi ndii dow rewde annditorɗe yimɓe e keewal neesuuji;
Sugilirɓe garintinde haɓanagol leydi e ndeenaagu mum yo waajibi faa goodal mayri tabita ;
Ɓamɓe anniya darjinde jawle finaa-tawaa, tabitiɗɗe e miijaaɗe fuu, reenude jawle tawaaɗe leydi ndii wonande baale gooduɗe e garooje ɗee fuu ;
Anniyiiɓe yirwinde mosalaa jamaa ;
Tabintini jilli mum’en semmbinde keɓe kaɓɓondirɗe e laamu potondiral jaltuɗo rewolisiyon 26 marsi hitaande 1991 e yirwinde miijooji moƴƴintingol leydi ngol yimɓe Mali kawri e mum ;
Ɓamii aadi reende laamu oo, ndeental leydi ndii e kiɓɓal mayri ;
Tabintinii kasen haɓɓagol mum e alhaali leydi ndi suudu baaba wi’anta hoore mum e ndi potal dinaaji ;
Ɓamii aadi wadde ko waawi fuu faa haɓa e yurkuyurku e faggitagol jawdi karmungol e yirwinde laamu poocciiɗo ;
Ɓamii aadi gaarintinde yirwingol alhaali nguurndam e reenugol hawaalu ;

Siɲɲinii naatugol e Annditingol adunaaru nduu kaane Ɓii-aadama ɲennde 10 lewru desaamburu hitaande1948 kaɲum e Sariyaaji Afirik banngal hakkeeji Ɓii-aadama e yimɓe ɲennde 27 lewru juwen hitaande 1981 ;

Ɓamii aadi gaarintinde tenndingol hakkeeji Ɓii-aadama, dow heertanaade hakke debbo, suka e neɗɗo ɲakuɗo, ɗe aadiiji e kawre leyɗe caggal leydi ndii, ndewguuji mayri e leyɗe adunaaru nduu kawri e mum, so Mali siɲɲini tabintini ;
Ɓamii aadi haɓude e kala alhaaliiji ɲanngere fuu ;

Tabintinde kasen haɓɓagol mum e tabitingol dental Afirik, yirwingol jam, paabondiral e leyɗe seraaji ɗee, ndewguuji e leyɗe adunaaru nduu, rewrintingol jamjamaawol haɓooji hakkunde leyɗe dow rewde sariya, potal, ndimaaku e hewtaare laamu ;
Nuuygal sariyaaji ngal, ngal puɗirka kaa jeydaa e mum siɲɲinii :
TIITOONDE I : BANNGAL HAKKEEJI E GOLLEEJI
TUMMBITERE I: BANNGAL KAANDE E DIMAAKUUJI

Sariyaawol 1ɓol : Ɓiɓɓe Mali fuu yo rimaaɓe, hewtuɓe hoore mum, ɓe potu e kaande ɗee. Kala ceenndiigu pawiiɗo dow iwdi neɗɗo, ndewgu, noone, ɗemngal, sii, leɲol, debbo naa gorko, diina naa miijo politik ana haɗaa.
Sariyaawol 2 : Ɓinngel-aadama ana teddi memataake. Kala neɗɗanke fuu ana haandi e nguurndam, ndimaaku, ndeenaagu e kiɓɓal calɗi mum.
Sariyaawol 3 : Leydi ndii gaarintinta reenugol suka iwde e soottugol yimɓe e luutti sariya goɗɗi e winndagol ley pelle murtereeɓe bomɓe .
Sariyaawol 4 : Fey gooto waawaa wajimbineede dow mum torra bonɗo, maccungaaku, ngaɗuki mbonki, cattuki, aybinoowi.
Kala neɗɗanke, golloowo Leydi ndii nanngaaɗo e ɗii golleeji, so wii hoore mum, so goɗɗo yamiri ɗum, waran jukkeede hono no sariya wiiri nii.
Sariyaawol 5 : Fey gooto ferngo waawaa wajimbineede dow mum.
Kala ɓii-aadama torraaɗo ngam goonɗinal mum politik naa diina, jeyegol makko e leɲol, ana waawi heɓude duruwa ferngo faa reeno ley leydi ndii.
Sariyaawol 6 : Kala ɓii-aadama mo huunde taweteende ana itta nndimaaku memiiɗum won duruwa ƴeewtude hoore mum to dogotoro mo muuyi.
Fey gooto waawaa nanngeede uddee ko ɓuri leeruuji debe e jeetti so wanaa so dow yamiroore juuju.
Fey gooto waawaa nanngeede uddee e gollirde kasu so wanaa so juuju hokki talkuru nanngirdu.
Sariyaawol 7 : Kala ɓii-aadama fuu won duruwaa e sariya jaadirɗo kaɲum e sareneede ley sarti kakindiiɗo.
Kaandal e walleede, rewta hen faaboreede awoka mo muuyi, ana garintinaa illa e anketti aranndeejo oo.
Kala noddaaɗo sariya fuu ana tuumanaa felnaaki illa ɗoo faa suudu sariya nduu tabintina felloore ndee e makko.
Gooto fuu e jukkungo mum. Fey gooto waawaa jokkiteede, nanngeede naa happeede so wanaa so taw sariya tabintinaama ko adii golleeji mo ɲiŋaa e mum ɗii.
Sariyaawol 8 : Kala ko sariya haɗaali fuu waawaa haɗeede, fey gooto duu waawaa wajimbineede waɗa ko ka yamiraali.
Sariyaawol 9 : Dewgal e galle yo fonndoode tawaande, Laamu leydi ndii reenata ɗum so toowna darja mum.
Dewgal yo deental hakkunde debbo e gorko.
Sariyaawol 10 : Jannde, ekkitagol, golle, suudu, weltaareeji, cellal, ndeenaagu yimɓe, ɲaamdu e hedde ndiyam fuu yo hakkeeji annditeteeɗi.
Sariyaawol 11: Kala ɓii-leydi fuu ana haandi e janngineede. Jannde foroba ndee yo waajibi, nde yoɓantaake, nde fonnunde dinaaji.
Sariyaawol 12: Galle, boowal, nguurndam e ley galle, kabaaruuji keertanaaɗi neɗɗo, sirri ɓataaki e kumpiti fuu waawa firriteede. Ɗi mbaawaaka memeede kina taw dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii.
Sariyaawol 13: Kaandal e jeyal ana gaarintinaa. Fey gooto waawaaka teeteede huunde so wanaa so foroba nawtortoo ɗum, e ko adii duu, hokkee njomnaari laaɓundi.
Sariyaawol 14 : Kala ɓii-aadama fuu ana haandi e hewtude hoore mum banngal miilo, ndimaaku wonki, suɓaade ndiina, ko rewata, ndimaaku miijo e haala, kaa dow rewde sariya.
Sariyaawol 15 : Ndimaaku haala haɓɓondirka e anndinde e kaandal humpiteede fuu ana anndaa, ana gaarintinaa. Ɗi gollete dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii.
Sariyaawol 16 : Ndimaaku moƴƴingol golle ɲeeɲal, fijo e neesu ana anndaa, ana garintinaa. Amo gollee dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii.
Sariyaawol 17 : Etaa ana anndita, ana garintina, dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii, ndimaaku yaade e warde ɗo yiɗi, ndimaaku suɓanaade hoore mum hoɗorde, ndimaaku waalde, batu, ɗowtondiral, maajagol .
Sariyaawol 18 : Kaandal e golle e fooftere ana anndaa e fotu e kala
Fey gooto waawaa wajimbineede golle anniyaaɗo so wanaa taw ɗum laatoo golle keertanaaɗo nafaa foroba, potuɗo e kala, dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii
Sariyaawol 19 : Ndimaaku senndika ana garintinaa. Senndika waɗan golle mum tawee waldaa e ɓillaare, walaa kaaddi ngonndi kinaa dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii.
Sariyaawol 20 : Kaandal e salagol golle ana garintinaa e droit de grève est garanti. Engal waɗiree dow rewde laawi sariya gollirteeɗi hannde ɗii.
Sariyaawol 21 : Ndimaaku gollande hoore mum ana garintinaa dow rewde laawi sariya gollirteeɗi hannde ɗii.
Sariyaawol 22 : Kala ɓii-aadama fuu ana haandi e hawaalu ceniiɗo, ɲiiɓuɗo.
TUMMBITERE II : BANNGAL GOLLEEJI
Sariyaawol 23 : Kala leydiyanke gonɗo ley leydi Mali ana haani ɗowtanaade nuuygal sariyaaji ngal e ley alhaaliiji ɗii fuu.
Sariyaawol 24 : Haɓanaade suu-baaba ana wajibii e leydiyanke fuu
Leydiyanke fuu keɓuɗo duuɓi 18 ana waawi naatude e soldasaaku faa haɓonoo suudu-baaba.
Sariyaawol 25 : Reenugol hawaalu e yirwingol alhaali nguurndam ana wajimbini e leydiyanke fuu kaɲum e laamu leydi.
Sariyaawol 26 : So won masiiba maataa, kala leydiyankooɓe fuu ana kaani faabaade dow sarɗiiji ɗi sariya hiitii .
Sariyaawol 27 : Kala leydiyanke fuu ana haani gollude golle ɓii-leydiyankaaku, hono yoɓude lampooji mum.
Sariyaawol 28 : Kala leydiyanke fuu ana haani humanaade golle foroba, teddinde e haybude jawdi foroba.
Sariyaawol 29 : Kala leydiyanke fuu kalfinaaɗo laamu naa jogiiɗo darnde wonnde naa daraniiɗo gollal sarwuusi foroba ana haani gollude wondude e hakkille, dewal e laaɓal.
TIITOONDE II : BANNGAL LEYDI E NDIMAAKU
TUMMBITERE I : BANNGAL LEYDI
Sariyaawol 30 : Mali yo leydi ngootiri hewtundi ndimaaku mum, ndi feccataake, ndi demokaraasi woni e mum, ndi potal diinaaji, njogiindi neɗɗaaku
Sarɗi mayri yo goforneman yimɓe, gaɗaaɗo yimɓe, gaɗanaaɗo yimɓe.
Kapital leydi Mali yo Bamako. Engal waawi sottineede yaade e nokku goɗɗo ley leydi dow bi’aangol sariya.
Annditorde mayri yo deesewal joogiingal nooneeji tati caawngal leppi tati dartiiɗi potuɗi : hoɗu-heccowol, oolol e boɗewol.
Kunorgol mayri yo: « Leydi - Anniya – Bakkilal ».
Yimre ndimaku leydi ndii yo: « Mali ».
Sariya sifotoo maaɗe mayri, tiloo darna sarɗiiji e laawi nawtoragol majje.
Kala nawtoragol bonngol e bonnugol sifaaji leydi ndii ana jukkee ley sariya
Sariyaawol 31 : Ɗemle leydi ndii yo ɗemle ɗe sarwuusi Mali haalata.
Sariya onngoowo sifotoo sarɗiiji e laawi nawtoragol majje.
Laamu oo ana waawi suɓaade ɗemngal gonngal faa ngal laato gollirgal
Sariyaawol 32 : Potal diinaaji luuttondirtaa e dinaa kaɲum e deweteeɗi goɗɗi. Faanda maggal yo yirwinde e semmbinde baaldal lobbal dow muɲondiral, kaaldal e paamondiral.
Laamu leydi ndii gaarintinta teddingol kala dinaaji, kulle deweteeɗe goɗɗe, ndimaaku wonki e waawde rewde ko muuyi hono sariya wiiri nii.
Sariyaawol 33 : Laamu jamaa ana fawii dow sarɗiiji paabondiral, potal, jaadiral, reenugol e naatondiral jamaa.
Sariyaawol 34 : Golle laamu ana tuugii sarɗiiji pawiiɗi dow rewgol ndimaaku leydi ndii, suɓagol kaanankooɓe yimɓe e reenugol hakkeeji mum.

Sariyaawol 35 : Laamunke fey gooto waawaa, fati o naata e farati jukkungo, nawtoraade laamu mo o jogii ley nuuygal sariyaaji ngal naa sariyaaji goɗɗi gooduɗi faa tawee omo wujjana hoore makko jawdi foroba, naa mo wujjana laamunkooɓe, kooreeji galle, baale, naa kala goɗɗo tawaaɗo fuu saabe heedaare, yurkuyurku, jammba, soodde hakkille neɗɗo, naa maɲeeje goɗɗe
Sariyaawol 36 : Joolle mawɗe gollirɗe leydi ndii yo:
Waajorde banngal keɓal, neɗɗaaku, hawaalu e finaa-tawaa
TUMMBITERE II : BANNGAL NDIMAAKU
Sariyaawol 37 : Ɓiɓɓe-leydi ndii darontoo ndimaaku leydi ndii, ley majjum, heƴaaɓe suɓaaɓe ley woteeji ɓee darontoo tabintingol majjum ɓee.
Guɓal yimɓe fey gootal, non neɗɗo fey gooto waawaa hokkude hoore mum oo golle
Sariyaawol 38 : Wote oo yo wote jamaa fuu, omo foti e kala, omo waɗiree cuuccukka. Omo waawi laataade wote cuppiiɗo naa wote suɓtaaɓe
Ley no sariya darniri nii, wotooɓe yo kala ɓiɓɓe-leydi Mali, so ɓe rewɓe, so ɓe worɓe, yottiiɓe wotude hiɓɓinɓe hakkeeji ɓii-leydiyaaku e politikaaku mum’en.
Sariyaawol 39 : Baale politik ɗee ndaɗondiran e ley wote. Le majjum, ɓe ndeetan ɓe ngaɗa golleeji maɓɓe hono no sariya wiiri nii.
Eɓe kaani ɗowtanaade sarɗiiji ndimaaku leydi ndii, demokaraasi oo, kiɓɓal leydi ndii, gootummaaku mayri kaɲum e potal diinaaji leydi ndii.
Sariyaawol 40 : Baale soosiyete siwil ɗee darontoo tabintingol leydiyankaaku banngal demokaraasi hono no sariya wiiri nii.
Sariyaawol 41 : Laamu oo daronto tabintingol ndimaaku mum oo dow leydi ndii fuu .
Laamu oo waawaa yoppude fey tayre wootere leydi ndii, non duu waawataa ɗalde hakke fey gooto kaɓɓondirɗo e ndimaaku mo donnata dow mayri oo.
Kala golle fuu luuttondirɗo e kiɓɓal leydi ndii yo ɲaakko’aaku pewtuɗo ndeenaagu leydi, ndii
Sariyaawol 42 : Laamu ana jogii hakke mawɗo dow jawle tawaaɗe gonɗe ley leydi ndii
Nawtoragol majje ana haani garintineede dow ɗowtanagol sariyaaji reenugol hawaalu oo, tawee duu iɗum nafaa jamaanu gooduɗo e garooje oo fuu.
TIITOONDE III : BANNGAL LAAMU GOLLIRƊO
TUMMBITERE I : BANNGAL PERSIDAN LEYDI NDII

Sariyaawol 43 : Persidan leydi ndii woni hooreejo mayri. Kanko haybata nuuygal sariyaaji ɗii. Kanko daronto gootummaaku leydi ndii. Kanko woni garanti ndimaaku leydi ndii, kiɓɓal mayri, teddingol aadiiji e kawre leyɗe adunaaru nduu. Kanko haybata no golle laamu fooccorto, reenata jokkondiral leydi ndii.
Sariyaawol 44 : Persidan leydi ndii tinndinta politik mayri
Sariyaawol 45: Joonnde laamu persidan leydi ndii yo duuɓi joy. Wote cuppiiɗo mo wotantee. Nde wootere tan mo waawi wotaneede kasen.
No laatii fuu, persidan fey gooto waawaa ƴaɓɓaade joolle ɗiɗi ɗee.
Sariyaawol 46 : Kala tewtoowo laataade persidan leydi ndii fuu ana haanii laataade ɓii-leydi ndii gilla e iwdi, mo haanaa tawreede talkuru hollooru omo jeyaa leydi ngonndi ɲennde omo tewta laamu oo.
Omo haani tawreede hakkeeji leydiyankaaku e politikaaku ɗii fuu. Mo tawree needi e laabal lobbal
Famɗi fuu o tawree duuɓi 35 e heewi fuu fati mo ɓura duuɓi 75 so omo tewtaa laamu, tawee duu omo waawori e golle oo.
Sariyaawol 47 : Wote persidan keso leydi ndii watte famɗi fuu balɗe capanɗe nay e joy e heewi duu fuu balɗe capanɗe jeegom ko adii timmugol joonnde persidan gooduɗo oo.
Sariyaawol 48 : Persidan leydi ndii ana suɓoree dow ɓural mawngal hakke wotuɓe
So ngal heɓaaka ley wote arannde oo, wote ɗiɗoɓo landinante ley alan tatoɓo jokkoowo e jaabu mo suu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu holliti e wote arandeejo oo

So ley balɗe jeɗɗi adiiɗe wote aranndeejo oo ɗee, gooto e tewtooɓe laamu ɓee maayii naa won ujuuru hanndi ɗum, Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu ana waawi sottinde sarti wote oo, tawee o ƴaɓɓaaki balɗe sappo e joy.
Wote ɗiɗoɓo oo ana feewti wotanteeɓe ɗiɗon heɓuɓe ɓural mawngal wotuɓe ley wote aranndeejo oo..
Gotanteeɗo ɓurɗo fuu heewde adadu wotuɓe yo kaɲum suɓetee
So gooto e tewtooɓe laamu heɓɓe yaade e wote ɗiɗoɓo ɓee maayii naa yaltitii hen naa won ujuuru hewtii ɗum, kanndida jokkoowo e makko oo ɓamata darnde makko.
Hakkunde woteeji ɗiɗi ɗii, so gooto e kanndidaa en ɓee maayii, naa ujuuru hewtike ɗum, Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu ana waawi sottinde wote oo tawee ƴaɓɓaaki balɗe sappo e joy.
Sariyaawol 49 : Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu haybata fooccagol wote persidan leydi ndii ; kayru sarata kiiti gullitaali gaɗaaɗi e wote oo, ndu tiloo ndu hollita jaabu wote oo.
Sariyaawol 50 : Sariya hiɓɓintinta sarɗiiji kaɓɓondirɗi e wote persidan leydi ndii.
Sariyaawol 51: Golleeji persifdan leydi ndii yaadaata e golle politik goɗɗe, joonnde wotanteende wonnde, kaliifa wote goɗɗo, golle laamu goɗɗo e kala golle meccee goɗɗo naannoowo.

Sariyaawol 52 : Ley joonnde makko kanko persidan oo, mo waawataa, so kanko e hoore makko, so nelaaɗo goɗɗo, faggitaade naa luɓaade fey huunde wonnde e jeyal leydi ndii. Mo waawaa duu, so kanko e hoore makko, so nelaaɗo goɗɗo, taweede e luumooji foroba e wonande sarwuusiiji naa gollirɗe mawɗe jeydaaɗe e laamu leydi ndii, gonɗe wii mum.
Sariyaawol 53 : So ujuuru haɗii persidan leydi ndii wadde golleeji mum ley wattu seeɗa, laamu makko oo tottete permel ministiri oo fade ndeen.

So joonnde persidan leydi ndii ɓoolɗi, ko laati sabaabu mum fuu naa ujuuru tilsundu naa timmundu tayka mum hollitaa Suudu nuugal sariyaaji nduu iwrude to persidan Asammbile, persidan sena e to permel ministiri, golleeji persidan leydi ndii tottete ndenkaa persidan Asammbile oo. So won ko haɗi mo, so yoppitin laamu naa maayde naati hen, golleeji makko ɗii tottete persidan Sena oo.
Wote persidan leydi keso watte famɗi fuu ley balɗe capanɗe jeenay e heewi fuu ley balɗe teemedere e noogay caggal taykagol ɓoolɗugol joonnde ndee naa ujuuru tilsundu timmundu nduu.
Kaananke loomtiiɗo persidan leydi ndii oo waawaa laataade kanndida ley wote bi’aaɗo oo.
Ley alhaaliiji ɓoolɗugol joonnde ɗii fuu, loomto oo waawaa donnude ɗii sariyaaji 57, 60, 69, 70 e 184 gonɗi ley nuugal sariyaaji goodungal ngal.
Sariyaawol 54 : Le Président élu entre en fonction à l’expiration du mandat du Président en exercice.
Sariyaawol 55 : Fade makko fuɗɗude golle, persidan leydi ndii waatoto yeeso Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu, yeeso jamaa tedduɗo, baatorgo garoowol ngol :

« Mi huniima, yeeso Alla e yimɓe rimɓe Mali, rewde e rewnude nuuygal sariyaaji ngal e sariyaaji goɗɗi, reenude laamu leydi ndii, wadde golleeji am dow nafaa mawɗo leydi ndii, reenude hakkeeji e ndimaaku ɓii-aadama, keɓe demokaraasi e jawdi foroba, gaarintinde ngootummaaku leydi ndii, hewtaare suudu-baaba e kiɓɓal leydi ndii, laataade dewoowo laaɓuɗo leydi ndii, waɗude ko mbaaw-mi fuu banngal tabintingol deental afirik.
So mi fiiritii ngol kunol, ala yo pati leydi ndii hoolam kasen, ɲaarre sariya oo mema kam ».

Sariyaawol 56 : Caggal yammbere joƴƴingol e laamu ndee, persidan leydi ndii hollitan jawdi mum fuu e binndi weeɗa persidan Suudu daraniindu kontuuji jawdi nduu. Nduu talkuru kollitol jawdi heyɗintinte hitaande fuu faa yoppugol golle.
Persidan daraniiɗo konti humpititta yimɓe dow ko tabintinaa e golle talkuru nduu kaɲum e ko haani heyɗintineede e mayru.

Sariyaawol 57 : Persidan leydi joƴƴinta Permel Ministiri ; kanko waawi duu ittude on e darnde mum. Persidan leydi ndii joƴƴinta yimɓe goforneman woɓɓe ɓee caggal lamndondiral makko e permel ministiri oo, kanko waawi duu ittude ɓe e darɗe maɓɓe.
Sariyaawol 58 : Persidan leydi ndii laamotoo batu ministiri’en ɓee. Permel ministiri loomtotoo mo dow yamiroore makko, kaɲum yamirta duu ko batetee dow mum koo.
Sariyaawol 59: Persidan leydi ndii sellita sariyaaji ɓamaaɗi ɗii ley balɗe sappo e joy caggal nde goforneman oo hokkaa sariyaaji kawraaɗi dow mum ɗii.
So wardi e yaawnaare, sellingol sariyaaji ɓamaaɗi ɗii ana waawi waɗeede le balɗe jeetti.
Fade sarti oo hiɓɓude, persidan oo ana waawi tewtirde depite’en ɓee mbata kasen dow sariya kaa naa yoga e sariyaaji ɗii
Oo batu waawaaka saleede e kanko duu darnata sarti sellingol ngol.

Sariyaawol 60 : Persidan leydi ndii, dow bi’aangol mum naa e bi’aangol Asammbile e Sena, caggal yamiroore nde Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu yeeyni ley juurnal laamu, omo waawi yamirde referandom waɗee dow kabaaruuji nafaa leydi ndii, dow heeƴo sariya pawiiɗo dow juɓɓondiral laamuuji, jaɓangol kawral deental naa yamirgol sellingol aadi taweteendi won garte dow no golle sarwuusiiji mawɗi laamu oo yaarata, tawee ɗun luuttaali nuuygal sariyaaji ngal.
So referandom oo sellinii jaɓugol poroje oo, Persidan leydi ndii tonngan sariya kaa ley sarti gonɗo ley sariyaawol 59 ngol.
Sariyaawol 61 : Nde wootere ley hitaande, ley lebbi tati arandeeji ɗii, Persidan leydi ndii sefoto dow alhaali leydi ndii ley batu deppite’en ɓee.

Sariyaawol 62 : Persidan leydi ndii neldan persidan Asammbile oo e persidan Sena oo ɓataakiiji, ɓe njannga ɓe kumpitoo. Caggal joonnde ndee, Asammbile naasonal e Sena njoƴƴinan batu kertaaɗo dow majjum.
Sariyaawol 63 : Persidan leydi ndii woni hooreejo toowɗo soldaasi’en. Kanko woni hoore batu ndeenaagu leydi ndii e komite ndeenaagu leydi ndii.
Persidan leydi ndii yamirta mooɓondiral mawngal jamaa tiloo holla laawi no leydiyanke faabortoo suu-baaba so ɗun tilsii.
Sariyaawol 64 : Persidan leydi ndii woni hooreejo toowɗo waajorde mawnde juuju ɓee.
Sariyaawol 65 : Persidan leydi ndii jogii hakke yaafago kasunkooɓe. Kanko hollata sariyaaji yaafaamuya ɓameteeɗi.
Sariyaawol 66 : Persidan leydi ndii siɲɲinta jamirooje ɓamaaɗe ley batu ministiri en.
Sariyaawol 67 : Persidan leydi ndii joƴƴinta yimɓe ley joolle toowɗe ɗe sariya darni.

Sanseliye mawɗo leydi ndii, ofisee’en mawɓe ɓee, ammbasadeer en e nelaaɓe heertaaɓe ɓee, goforneer en reeson ɓee, direkteer en sarwuusiiji mawɗi ɓee fuu yo dekere ɓamaaɗo ley batu ministiri en joƴƴinta ɗum’en.
Joƴƴingol maɓɓe ana fawii dow sarɗiiji mawɗi banngal baawe, mbarkaanaaku e laaɓal
Sariyaawol 68 : Persidan leydi ndii joƴƴinta ammbasadeer en e nelaaɓe heertaaɓe ley leyɗe goɗɗe e ley baale leyɗe adunaaru nduu.
Ammbasadeer en e nelaaɓe heertaaɓe ana neldee nokku makko kanko duu.
Sariyaawol 69 : Persidan leydi ndii ana waawi, caggal lamndondiral mum e persidan’en Saamburuuji deppite’en ɗiɗi ɗii kaɲum e persidan Suudu nuugal sariyaaji nduu, yamirde sammingol Asammbile nasonal.
Sammingol Asammbile ngol waawaa waɗeede ley lebbi sappo e ɗiɗi aranndeeji caggal jooɗagol makko, naa duu so tawii hiitagol laamu hollitaama jaɓaama.
Woteeji mawɗi ɗii ana ngaɗee famɗi fuu ley balɗe capanɗe jeegom naa heewi fuu balɗe teemedere e noogay caggal sammingol Asammbile.
Sammingol gonngol fuu waawaa waɗeede ley hitaande jokkoore e nde woteeji ɗii ngaɗaa ndee
So sarti tonngaaɗo e sariyaawol tatoɓol ngol hiɓɓii, tawii woteeji deppite’en ɗii lanndinaaka, Asammbile nasonal camminaaɗo oo wartirte e golle.

Sariyaawol 70 : So gollirɗe sarwuusi mawɗe ɗee, ndimaaku leydi ndii, kiɓɓal mayri, gollugol aadiiji ɓamondiraaɗi e leyɗe adunaaru nduu kulɓinaama ɗoon e ɗoon no boniri, laato no golle laamorɗe leydi ndii yaarata nii fooccaaki, Persidan leydi ndii ana waawi fiide dabareeji keertaaɗi tilsuɗi saabe alhaali oo, caggal lamndondirgol makko e permel ministiri oo, e persidan Asammbile oo, Sena oo e Suudu nuuygal sariyaaji nduu.
Mo humpintiniran Leydi ndii ɓataaki.
Parleman oo batan dow sariya.
Persidan leydi ndii, donnugol makko ɗii laamuuji, no laatii fuu haanaa bonnude ndimaaku leydi ndii kaɲum e kiɓɓal mayri.
Laamuuji keertaaɗi ɗii, ana kaani faandaade reende golle leydi ndii fati daroo, ɗi ndartina golle gollirɗe sarwuusi mawɗe ɗee no yaawri hono no nuuygal sariyaaji ngal wiiri nii
Ley golle laamuuji keertaaɗi ɗii, gollirde mawnde fey wootere waawaaka sammineede naa sinndeede.
Sariyaaji ɓamaaɗi Asammbile ley wattu nde laamuuji keertaaɗi ɗii gollata ndee gollirtaake so Asammbile sellinaali ɗi ley sarti balɗe capanɗe jeenay caggal ko ɗi puɗɗi gollireede koo.
Sariyaawol 71 : Persidan leydi ndii ana waawi halfinde yoga e laamu mum oo permel ministiri.
Golleeji Persidan leydi ndii ɗi ngaldaa e kollaaɗi ley sariyaaji 57, 60, 65, 69 e 70 kaɲum e tayre winndannde sariyaawol goodungol ngol yo permel ministiri siɲɲindinta e makko
Sariyaawol 72 : Sariya darnata nafakaaji dokketeeɗi Persidan leydi gooduɗo oo e persidan en leydi hiiɓɓe heddodiiɓe e hakke leydiyankaaku ɓee.
Sariyaawol 73 : Persidan leydi ndii ana waawi kalmeede so mo tawaama e jammba mawɗo
Asammbile ana waawi ittude mo so mo tawaama e jammba mawɗo.
Ɗum yo jammba mawɗo so Persidan leydi fiirtii waatoo mum.
Hiitagol ittugol makko ngol yo gooto gooto e yimɓe Saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii ɓamata anniya mum. Ngol jaɓantaake kinaa taawee famɗi fuu ɗo taton ngoni fuu taton ciɲɲina e yimɓe ɓee.
Saamburu wondaandu nduu haaldan e waalde barkaniire ndee faa fuɗɗa honnjooji e lamndi bajibiiɗi ɗii, ley majjum, waalde ndee hiitoo yalla laawol ngol ana waawi jokkeede naa ngol waawaa.
So waalde ndee hiitiike wiide ngol waawaa jokkeede, laawol ittugol makko ngol darnete
So waalde ndee hiitiike wiide omo haani jokkiteede saamburuuji ɗii ngotanan ɗum.

So ittugol makko ngol jaɓaama, ɗun hollitinte Saamburu wonndu nduu ley sarti balɗe jeetti, indu haani hollitinde hono mum ley sarti balɗe sappo e joy. So happugol ngol jaɓaaka, laawol ittugol ngol darnete
Saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii, happugol majji ana sabinbina, dow sariya, sammingol ɓure Persidan leydi ndii.
Saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii, e ley majjum, mbatidan dow ittugol Persidan leydi ndii e laamu. Ittugol makko e laamu ngol ana warree dow wote, ɗo nayon ngoni fuu taton njaɓana ittugol ngol
Daaɗe wotanɓe ittugol makko ngol tan hiisetee. Batuuji jooɗotooɗi ley majjum ɗii yo persidan Kuur siperem ardotoo ɗum.
Persidan leydi ndii ana jogii hakkeeji tewtude faabotooɓe. Omo waawi faabitoraade awoka omo yiɗi ley laawi sariya ɗii fuu.
Sariya keertaaɗo famminta sarɗiiji donnugol sariyaawol goodungol ngol.
Sariyaawol 74 : Persidan leydi ndii, kaɲum darotoo yeeso gollirɗe sariya foroba banngal jukkungooji ɲaakko’aakue bonanndaaji gaɗɗi ɗi ngaldaa e golleeji makko ɗii.
Kaanoo, waawaaka wajimbineede e makko mo seedo, naa mo jokkitee, naa anketti waɗee dow makko illa ɗoo faa kaliifa laamu makko timma. Kala sarti banngal jokkitagol makko sariya sinndaama
Lamndi e laawi sariya tonnguɗi mo ɗii ana waawi ɓamteede feewde e makko lewru caggal yaltugol makko e laamu.
TUMMBITERE II : BANNGAL GOFORNEMAN
Sariyaawol 75 : Goforneman oo yo permel ministiri hooreejo goforneman oo, e ministiri en woɓɓe ɓee .
Sariya keertaaɗo darnata adadu yimɓe goforneman oo.
Sariyaawol 76 : Goforneman oo daronto politik leydi ndii, mo persidan leydi ndii hiitii. Njuɓɓudi sarwuusiiji laamu oo e jeyal makko woni.
Sariyaawol 77 : Permel ministiri oo kaɲum woni hooreejo goforneman oo. Ley majjum, kanko wi’anta golleeji goforneman oo
Kanko daronto gollal sariyaaji ngal. Kaa sarɗi mum yo rewde sariyaaji 66 e 67 ɗii, Kanko sabiminta rewgol sariyaaji.
Omo waawi halfinde yoga e laamu makko oo ministiri’en woɓɓe ɓee.
Kanko loomtotoo persidan leydi ndii banngal hooreyaaku batu ministiri’en dow heertaade ko batetee dow mum koo.
Kanko loomtotoo on banngal hooreyaaku waajorde e komite daraniiɗo ndeenaagu leydi ndii oo fuu.
Talki permel ministiri oo, won no warrata, yo ministiri’en woɓɓe daraniiɓe golle majji ɓee ciɲɲindinta e makko.
Sariyaawol 78 : Goforneman oo hawjotoo golleeji ɗii tiloo haaltana persidan leydi ndii
Sariyaawol 79 : Yimɓe goforneman oo ndokkan Kuur daraniiɗo kontuuji oo talkuru kollital jawdi maɓɓe ley binndi ley sarti heewi fuu fati ƴaɓɓo balɗe capantati caggal joonnde maɓɓe
Persidan kuur kontuuji oo martinan jamaa oo kumpa kiɓɓal talkuru nduu e keyɗintini kaanɗi waɗeede e mum.
Sarɗiiji Sariyaawol 52 ngol ana mbaawi donneede dow yimɓe goforneman ɓee.

Sariyaawol 80 : Permel ministiri oo hollan, yeeso Asammbile oo, heeƴo golleeji anniyaaɗi goforneman oo. Hollugol ngol waɗan yeeso gooto gooto e saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii fuu heewi fuu balɗe capantati caggal haala Persidan Leydi ndii dow no alhaali mayri worri. Won no worrata, jokkenee e haala Persidan oo yeewtere wondunde e jamirooje

Sariyaawol 81 : Golleeji neɗɗo goforneman fuu yaadataa e golle kaliifa deppiteyaaku, naa wakiilaaku banngal meccee ley leydi ndii fuu naa bannge gooto mayri, naa kala golle foroba, naa golle meccee naannoowo kaalisi .
Sariyaawol 82 : Yimɓe goforneman ɓee kaɲum’en ndoondotoo kala ɲaakko’aakuuji naa bonanndaaji gaɗɗi ley laamu maɓɓe.
Kuur siperemu oo, kaɲum jogii baawe jokkitagol e lugagol. Sargol ngol e juuɗe tirbine sariya bone foroba ɗee woni.
Sarɗiiji dewtere sariya bone ndee donnata sariyaaji wonande jokkitagol ngol, lugagol ngol e sargol ngol.
TUMMBITERE III : BANNGAL NJUƁƁUDI LAAMU
Sariyaawol 83 : Laamu oo waɗata golleeji ceertuɗi ɗi nafaa mum yottotoo jamaa fuu, ɗi saabe mum gollirɗe ɗee joƴƴiniraa.

Sariyaawol 84 : Laamu oo faabotoo yirwingol keɓal, neɗɗaaku e neesu ley wattangol makko hakkille no wooɗiri e kasindine suudu-baaba e nawtortooɓe gollirɗe ɗee ley laaɓal, rewgol hakke ɓii-aadama e demokaraasi.
Sariyaawol 85 : Gollooɓe laamu ɓee ana kaani ley golleeji mum’en ɗowtanaade sariyaaji mawɗi onngooji sarwuusi laamu caawɗi laawol sariya, potal, rafi ɓurdinal, rafi jinngangol e jokkitagol golle.
Eɓe kaani rewde sariyaaji needi gollirɗi ɗii, ɓuri fuu banngal laaɓal e needi.
Sariyaawol 86 : Laamu leydi ndii wattanan hakkille ɓamugol yimɓe ley gollirɗe foroba dow rewde sariyaaji laaɓal, fonndugol yimɓe fuu, tawee golleeji maɓɓe duu ana fawoo dow baawe e mbarkaanaaku.
Sariyaawol 87 : Laamu leydi ndii wattana hakkille yalla gollooɓe ɓee ana keɓa alhaaliiji lobbi ley golleeji mum’en, njoddiiji lobbi e ndeenaagu tilsuɗum banngal wooɗingol golle maɓɓe oo.
TUMMBITERE IV : SUUDU LAAMU GOLLONOORU HOORE MUM

Sariyaawol 88 : Suudu laamu gollonooru hoore mum nduu, golleeji mayru yo banngal curundiral, dartingol, honnjagol e haybugol, reenugol ndimaakuuji e hakkeeji ɓiɓɓe-aadama, lanndingol e hawjagol woteeji ɗii.
Sariya joƴƴini Suudu laamu gollonooru hoore mum nduu.
TUMMBITERE V : BANNGAL LARME E NDEENAAGU
Sariyaawol 89 : Soldaasi’ en ɓee kumanii reenugol e kiɓɓal leydi ndii, reenugol yimɓe e jawle mum’en, ɲiiɓugol jam leydi ndii e tabintingol sariyaaji laamu
Kamɓe paabotoo golleeji banngal yirwere keɓal, neɗɗaaku, neesu e ndeenaagu hawaalu.
Sariyaawol 90 : Soldaasi en ɓee yo leydi ndii ɓe ngoni e wii mum. Laamu oo ɓe ngollanta, ɓe ngalaa e politik, eɓe ngolla dow yamiroore laamu oo
Sariyaawol 91 : Soldaasi en ɓee mbaawaa nawtoreede banngal irsi-orso jamaa leydi so wanaa ko sariya yamiri ɓe koo.
Sariyaawol 92 : Soldaasi en ɓee ana mbaawi neldeede ley leyɗe goɗɗe faa ɓe paaboo banngal ɲiiɓugol jam, deeƴere e ndeenaagu dow ɗowtanaade aadiiji leyɗe adunaaru gollidooje e Mali ɗee.

Sariyaawol 93 : Laamu leydi ndii tinnotoo yalla soldaasi en ɓee ana keɓa, no ɲiiɓiri, yimɓe gollooɓe e kaaki gollirɗi bajjimbiniiɗum ley golle maɓɓe oo. Lanndingol ɓamugol ɓee yimɓe e ɗii feereeji ana waɗiree heeƴo sariyaaji.
TIITOONDE IV : BANNGAL LAAMU DEPPITE’EN
TUMMBITERE I : BANNGAL SARƊIIJI MAWƊI
Sariyaawol 94 : Golle Asammbile yo wotugol sariyaaji.
Asammbile oo wotan sariyaaji, iimo no golleeji laamu oo yaarata
Sariyaawol 95 : Asammbile oo ana jogii saamburuuji ɗiɗi : Asammbile naasonal e Sena
Kongere yo batu saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii. Persidan Asammbile naasonal woni hoore Kongere oo, cukko makko yo persidan Sena.
Sariyaawol 96 : Yimmɓe Asammbile naasonal oo mbi’etee deppite’en
Deppite’en ɓee ana cuɓee e wote cuppiiɗo; kaliifa laamu maɓɓe yo duuɓi joy. Sii wote oo ana fawii dow ɓural wotuɓe, fonnugol naa jillugol.
Malinkooɓe jooɗiiɓe leyɗe goɗɗe ɓee ngon heƴaaɓe mum ley Asammbile oo hono no laawi sariya ɗii mbiiri nii
Sariyaawol 97 : Yimɓe Sena ɓee mbi’etee senateer.

Yimɓe womɓe ley Sena oo, ɗo nayon ngoni fuu taton ɓee yo yimɓe suɓaaɓe e wote cuppiiɗo; kamɓe ngoni heƴaaɓe suudu-baaba. Rewta hen Kasen duu, ɗo nayon ngoni fuu gooto e maɓɓe yo keƴaaɗo laamunkooɓe ɓee, ameeri en geelle ɓee, malinkooɓe jooɗiiɓe leyɗe goɗɗe e haalaa nane’en gollanɓe suudu-baaba ɓee.
Sarti joonnde yimɓe Sena oo yo duuɓi joy.
Sariyaawol 98 : Fey gooto waawaa laataade keƴaaɗo Asammbile naasonal e Sena darannde wootere.
Sariyaawol 99 : Sariya tinndinta laawi wote deppite’en Asammbile oo. Kanka hollata laawi wote suɓagol senateer’en.

Sariyaawol 100 : Sariya keertaaɗo gooto darnata, wonande gootel e Saamburuuji ɗiɗi ɗii, adadu yimɓe gollooɓe ɓee, kawral dow waawgol wotaneede, waayde waawde wotaneede e ko yaadataa. Sariya kaa ana fammina duu so golloowo Asammbile naa Sena ana wattitee so joonnde ɓolde maataama
Sariyaawol 101 : Sariya keertaaɗo darnata geenaari e nafakaaji goɗɗi dokketeeɗi deppite’en e senateer’en.
Sariyaawol 102 : Caggal fuɗɗugol maɓɓe golle oo, ley balɗe capantati, Persidan Kuur kontuuji oo neldete talkuru kollital jawdi deppite’en ɓee e senateer’en ɓee.
Ɗii talki kolliti jawdi ana kaani heyɗintineede hitaande fuu illa ɗo faa nde joomum yoppi golle.
Persidan Kuur kontuuji oo humpitinan jamaa oo kollital jawdi ngal e heyɗintingol mum.

Sariyaawol 103 : Deppite’en ɓee e senateer’en ɓee mbaawataa nawtoraade ɓure deppiteyaaku ɗee so wanaa so eɓe keddi e golle maɓɓe. Ɓe mbaawaa jokkiteede banngal sariya, naa uddeede kasu, naa jukkeede saabe miiijooji maɓɓe naa woteeji ɗi ɓe ngaɗi le joolle deppiteyaaku oo

Sariyaawol 104 : Kala deppite naa senateer jukkaaɗo saabe ɲaakko’aaku timmuɗo ittete e joonnde mum dow yamiroore ministiri kumaniiɗo sariya oo. Non ɗum worri duu feewde e kala deppite naa senateer jukkaaɗo kasu hitaande e ko fawii ko waldaa e muɲanal.
Sariyaawol 105 : Kala kaliifa jaawniiɗo fuu yo meere jatortee.
Hakke wote yimɓe Asammbile oo ɓee ana heertanaa gooto gooto e maɓɓe fuu. Sariya gollirɗo ana waawi heertaade yamira kaliifa wote oo. Ley majjum, fey gooto waawaa heɓude ko ɓuri kaliifa gooto.
Sariyaawol 106 : Kala deppite naa senateer jaltuɗo e parti politik mum naa e waalde nde mo laati keƴaaɗo mum ittete e joonnde mum..
Yaltugol maɓɓe e ley parti naa ley waalde ndee sellinirte talkuru. Naatugol e parti goɗɗo naa e waalde wonnde ana jatoree yoppitingol golle
Deppite naa senateer joppitinɗo darnde mum loomtinte no sariya gollirɗo oo wiiri nii
TUMMBITERE II : BANNGAL NO GOLLE ASAMMBILE OO YAARATA
Sariyaawol 107 : Asammbile naasonal e Sena ana njooddoto e batu, dow sariya, nde koyɗe ɗiɗi le hitaande .
Joonde aranndeere ndee ana fuɗɗa altineere aranndeere ley lewru oktoobuuru. Sarti joonnde ndee waawaa ƴaɓɓaade balɗe capanɗe jeɗɗi e joy.
Joonnde ɗiɗoɓerde ndee ana fuɗɗa altineere aranndeere ley lewru Aawiril. Sarti joonnde ndee waawaa ƴaɓɓaade balɗe capanɗe jeenay.

Sariyaawol 108: Asammbile ana waawi jooɗaade ley batu juujuure, so e dow bi’aangol persidan leydi ndii, naa duu e dow bi’aangol semmbe gollooɓe Asammbile nasonal oo naa Sena oo, dow heertaade ko batata dow mum.
So joonnde juujuure waɗii hen, dekere timminoowo golleeji ɗii ana siɲɲinee caggal so ko batetee dow mum koo tilike, heewi fuu ley balɗe sappo e joy caggal nde batu oo noddaa ndee
Sariyaawol 109 : So batuuji Asmmbile boowaaɗi ɗii yaltii hen, Persidan leydi ndii siɲɲinta dekere uditingol naa uddugol batuuji juujuure ɗii.
Sariyaawol 110 : Ana wajimmbinii e deppite naa senateer tawee ley batuuji noddeteeɗi ɗii,pati sariyaaji jukkungo Asammbile oo naa Sena oo ɗii ndoga dow maɓɓe..
Sariyaawol 111 : Gooto e saamburuuji ɗiɗi Asammbile oo ɗii fuu moƴƴinan sariyaaji mum’en gollirɗi. Kanji ndarnata duu sarɗiiji gollirɗi kongere oo.
Sariyaawol 112 : Persidan Asammbile nasonal oo e persidan Sena oo so ɓe cuɓaama e wote, ɓe keddoto e darɗe maɓɓe faa kaliifa joonnde ndee timma.
Sariyaawol 113 : Persidan Asammbile nasonal oo kaɲum e persidean Sena oo ana waawi itteetde e joonnde mum’en rafi rewgol golleeji ɓe kalfinaa.
Faa ittugol maɓɓe ngol jaɓee, kinaa ɗo taton ngoni e Saamburu gondaaɗo oo fuu, ɗiɗon mum’en ciɲɲina anniya ittugol ngol.
Laawol sariya ittugol e joonnde fey gootol anniya mum waawaa ɓameede ley duuɓi ɗiɗi jokkuɗi e joonnde Persidan Asammbile nasonal oo e Persidan Sena oo.
Ittugol ngol ana waɗiree ɓural taton dow nayon e saamburu gondaaɗo oo, hono no laawi sariya gollirɗi maɓɓe ɗii mbiiri nii.
So ittugol ngol sellii, Asmmbile nasonal oo naa Sena oo waɗan wote joƴƴinirɗo Persidan keso ley no sariyaaji gollirɗi maɓɓe ɗii mbiiri nii. Persidan keso oo hiɓɓintinta kaliifa persidan ittaaɗo oo.

Sariyaawol 114 : Joolle batu saamburuuji Asammbile oo yo foroba e homo fuu. Kaanoo, saamburu fuu ana waawi waɗande hiini-hoore mum batu cuuccukka naa dow bi’aangol goforneman. Sariyaaji gollirɗi ɗii pamminta laawi ɗii.
Talkuru kumpital kiɓɓal dow ko hawraa e batuuji ɗii winndete ley jurnal laamu.
