DULA FOLO : BOLOXOSARIYALU NIN KETALU {#dula-folo-:-boloxosariyalu-nin-ketalu}
DAKUN I : BOLOXOSARIYALU NIN FANMAHOOROYALU {#dakun-i-:-boloxosariyalu-nin-fanmahooroyalu}

Sariyasin 1folo : Malidinŋo bee hooroyaniŋo le be wulula, awa i bee xa xan boloxosariyalu nin ketalu to. Danfata man xan xa dun malidinŋolu si te, xa tali ke boloxosariyalu ni ketalu la. Kewalo fen wo fen be ɲatilinna danfato dunno ma malidinŋolu te, x’o sabaabo ke i bodula walante i siya, i balo keɲalu, i la xan fotalu, i la xeninmusuya, i la diinekuwo n’i hakililalu ma, wo kewalolu bee be xonnin sariya fe xa si a danŋo ma.

Sariyasin 2 nanŋo : Hadamadin si man xan xa ɲanxatan anin xa degu walante xa toxosi, wolu mennu s’a lamaluya anin x’a lanbe tiɲa. Hadamadinŋo kilin wo kilin xa xan xa balu, x’a fan ta, xa lakanta anin x’a la lanbe tu a ɲa ma.
Sariyasin 3 nanŋo : Fasuwo le xa xan xa dindinŋolu tanga fiirilo nin wo ɲoxon kewalelu ma anin x’e kisi i dunno ma kujaxukelalu la kafo xono.
Sariyasin 4nanŋo : Moxo si man xan xa nimatooro, xa jonyamuta anin xa marakujaxuya, x’a la hadamadinya toxosi.
Moxo wo moxo, fango la baarakela bee kilikilinna je nin kewale innu ke, i x’a ke i fan ma wo i bulata a la wo, sariya s’o tigo ɲangi.
Sariyasin 5nanŋo : Moxo si me diyakuwa no x’e la jamano bula.
Ɲanxatanŋo be siginin moxo wo moxo xan x’o sabaabo ke a la politikisila sugandininŋo ti, a la diinekuwo, a la siyakuwo xanma, Mali si wo tigo bisimila no.
Sariyasin 6nanŋo : Moxo wo moxo n’i xa xan xa muta x’e dataxun, wo tigo be yamaruyanin xa dogotooro sugandi men si jatemuta ke a la jangarukuwo folo.
Moxo si me muta no x’e dataxun xa tanbin leere mugan nin naani xan, fo n’i kiititegela yamaruyaninŋo xa lategelisafe la i xan.
Moxo si man xan xa dataxun kasobunŋo xono nin kiititegela man safe la i xan.
Sariyasin 7 nanŋo: Bee nin kiiti tilinninŋo xa xan wa kiito xa xan xa tege sarati haxxelama xono.
Lasafasalo nin lafasabaxo talo be yamaruyanin sariya la moxo nomutaninŋo kabirin segesegelo kun folo.
Moxo si me muta no x’o sabaabo ke sikko ti walante bisigo ti, fo kiitibunŋo x’a latege x’a xoyiya x’a be jalaginin kuwo men na, o m’a no ti.
Ɲangilo be ɲatilinnin sariya triɲabaxo le ma. Moxo si me nomuta no, x’e muta, x’e dun kaso la sariya fe men sigita i la kewale keninŋo xo..
Sariyasin 8 nanŋo : sariya man fen wo fen xon, o me bali no. Awa moxo me diyakuwa no xa fen ke sariya man men yamaruya.
Sariyasin 9 nanŋo : Futuwo nin kore, wolu mennu mu hadamadinya sinsinnanŋo ti, wolu be lakantanin fango fe.
Futuwo be daganin xe nin muso le te.
Sariyasin 10 nanŋo: Maro, xaranŋo, baaradigo, baaro kelo, sigidulakuwo, diyanɲekuwolu, kendeya, sabatisilolu anin lakantalo mu boloxosariyalu ti mennu xa xan xa sabati jamanadinŋo bee ɲen.
Sariyasin 11nanŋo : Fasudinŋo bee kilin wo kilin nin xaranŋo xa xan. Sariya s’a wajibiya dindinŋo bee xa dun lekolo la. Kenfanɲo la lekolisudayelo be yamaruyanin awa i xa xan xa lataxama sariya xono.
Sariyasin 12 nanŋo : I sidula, halalakeno, i toxolakuwolu, i la kore xonokuwolu, i la kunnafirinŋolu gullo, sariya m’a yamaruya moxo xa toxosili lasi wolu ma. Sariya le be wo taxabulolu lategela.
Sariyasin 13 nanŋo : Le droit de propriété est garanti. Nul ne peut être exproprié que pour cause d'utilité publique et contre une juste et préalable indemnisation.
Sariyasin 14 nanŋo : Tigiya boloxosariya be yamaruyanin anin xa lakanta bee ɲen. Moxo si halaalo me muta no a la fo n’a keta jama kunku ti, haali wo dun, bulotosaagi si ke a tigo ɲen x’a wasa.

Sariyasin 15 nanŋo : Bee si kunnafirinsafe dara no awa bee nin kunnafirinŋo xa xan. Lafasalitonŋolu la yamaruya b’e bulu awa i s’i la baarolu ke no fo xa si i diyanɲehaxxo ma, fo n’a x’a tara sariya xa mennu bali.
Sariyasin 16 nanŋo : Nokubaaro nin lonkubaaro sigilo sin xan yamaruya be bee bulu. A be waleyala i xo sariya x’a latege ɲa men.
Sariyasin 17 nanŋo : Sariya xa bee yamaruya i xa taxa i sagotodula, i x’e sigi i diyanɲedula, i xa dun i diyanɲekafu to, xa je ɲoxojekeno to anin tulunkeno to.
Sariyasin 18 nanŋo : Boloxosariya, baaro silatego la anin tofoɲolo silatego la, be yamaruyanin bee ɲen.
Fasudinŋo bee xa xan xa baaro ke, bari baara jonjon sifa kilin me wajibiya no moxo si xan, fo n’a keta jama haajuɲiɲabaara jonjon do ti sariya be men dantegenin.
Sariyasin 19 nanŋo : Lafasalitonŋolu sigilo be yamaruyanin. Lafasalitonŋolu la yamaruya b’e bulu, awa i s’i la baarolu ke no ɲa men x’e diya, fo nin sariya xa mennu bali.
Sariyasin 20 nanŋo : Baarabulo be yamaruyanin. A be kela sariya nin benxanŋo sigininŋolu xono.
Sariyasin 21nanŋo : Kenfanɲo baaradalu sigilo be yamaruyanin anin du, i be lakantanin sariya sigininŋolu fe.
Sariyasin 22 nanŋo : Hadamadinŋo bee ni laminin senun kuntaxalajanŋo xa xan.
DAKUN II : JAMANADINŊOLU LA KETALU {#dakun-ii-:-jamanadinŋolu-la-ketalu}
Sariyasin 23 nanŋo : Fasudin wo fasudin, moxo wo moxo n’i be siginin Mali jamano xono, i xa xan xa sariyajuba batu ɲa bee ma.
Sariyasin 24 nanŋo : Fasuwo lafasalo mu wajibo le ti fasudinŋo bee ma.
Fasudinŋo fen wo fen siyo doxoyaninba mu sanji 18 ti, si dun no sorodasiya to fasuwo lakantalo xanma.
Sariyasin 25 nanŋo : Lamininŋo lakantalo anin dunatotego keɲa newoyalo mu fasudinŋo bee nin fango kunku ti.
Sariyasin 26 nanŋo : Nin ɲanxatanŋo boyita jamano xan, fasudionŋo kilin wo kilin xa xan x’a sinkuwo bee ke, i xo sariya x’a fo ɲa men.
Sariyasin 27 nanŋo : Fasudinŋo bee xa xan x’e la fasudinya boloxosariyalu waleya, xerexerenninya la x’e la sagallolu sara.
Sariyasin 28 nanŋo : Fasudinŋo bee kilin wo kilin xa xan x’e tesiti jama la heerasoto xanma, anin xa furubafenŋo batu, x’a lakanta.
Sariyasin 29 nanŋo : Yamaruya dita fasudinŋo bee kilikilinna ma xa furubabaaro do ke walante xa ki furubabaaro do la, wo tigo xa xan x’o baaro ke tilinninya, hooroya nin ladiriya xono.
DULA II : JAMANO NIN HOOROYA {#dula-ii-:-jamano-nin-hooroya}
DAKUN I : JAMANO {#dakun-i-:-jamano}

Sariyasin 30 nanŋo : Mali mu jamana fanmahooroyanin, jamano men na kuwo tigiya b’a fan bulu, jamano men me tala no, awa a be lataxamala sariyafango sariyalu xono, jamana du mu diinolu nin hadamadinya be lasabatinin men xono.
A sigixanŋo mu jama la fanga sigininŋo, jama be fango men naborila ani fango be laborila jama men ɲen.
Mali la galluba mu Bamakon ne ti. Bari jamano dula xote si sugandi no xa ke galluba ti, n’o si ke sariya xono.
Mali jamano taagumanseedo mu faanuxono saba ti, mennu lokundanma xa xan : ɲugujima, sanujima, anin wulemanŋo.
A dasitixanŋo mu : « fasujama kilin-Kuntilinna kilin-Ŋanneya kilin ».
A majanmudonkilo toxo mu : « Mali » ti.
Sariya be fasuwo taagumanseedolu nin masitolu dantegela ani x’e la labaaralo lahalayalu n’i keɲalu pereperelatege.
Moxo wo moxo je jamano taagumanseedolu labaaraɲajaxu anin x’e mafeya, sariya s’o tigo ɲangi..
Sariyasin 31nanŋo : Fasuwo xanŋolu mu Mali xan yamaruyaninŋolu ti.
Sariya s’i labaarolu lahalayaw n’i keɲalu pereperelatege.
Jamano si xan xote sugandi no x’a ke baarakexanŋo ti.
Sariyasin 32nanŋo : Diinebeexaaɲano xoto nte xa diino nin lannayakuwolu b’e ɲoxo to. A kuntilinna mu xa sigiɲoxoya jiidi anin x’a sinsin, wo men be siginin muɲo, xumaɲoxoya anin ɲoxofaamo xan.
Jamano si diinolu, lannayakuwolu, diinemayelemo, diineyito bee lafasa.
Sariyasin 33nanŋo : Jamano mennu be siginin hadamadinya xan, wolu be sinsinnin ɲoxodeema, kilinya, tilinninya, lakantalo anin buludiɲoxomo xan. Jamano si feere jonjonŋolu tege wo xanma x’e waleya.
Sariyasin 34nanŋo : Jamano baaralo xa xan xa tanbi silo mennu fe, wolu mu jamano la hooroya bunyalo, jamanadinŋolu la sugandilolu anin i la nafalu lafasalo ti.

Sariyasin 35 nanŋo : Furubafango tigilamoxo si me i sinsinno sariyajuba la fanga dininŋolu xan walante sariya xan, xa fasuwo nafulo suɲa a fan ɲen walante fangaɲamoxolu ɲen, a la kore ɲen, baaradalu ɲen walante moxo xote ɲen x’a la tesilo xan, yuruguyurugo, nanbaro, sutofenmuto walante feere xotelu xan..
Sariyasin 36 : Jamano lolanŋolu mu :
Soto, hadamadinya, lonkuwo nin nokuwolu toxolabulunŋo.
DAKUN II : JAMANO LA HOOROYA {#dakun-ii-:-jamano-la-hooroya}
Sariyasin 37nanŋo : Jamano la hooroya mu jamanadinŋo bee kunku ti ; ate le be moxolu sugandila wotekela fan na wote sinfe, walante hakililaɲininwote sinfe..
Jamanadinkafu si walante moxo kilin si me a lataxamalo tigiya ta no.
Sariyasin 38nanŋo : Wote si ke jamanadinŋo bee fe, sariya xono, gullo to.
Si wote no, i xo sariya x’a latege ɲa men, malidinŋo bee kilikilinna, i keta xeba ti wo, i keta musu ti wo, men siyo sita wote ma, n’a la fasudin boloxosariyalu n’a politikisariyalu man tiɲa.
Sariyasin 39 nanŋo : Politikitonŋolu si fango ɲini. I s’i toben anin x’e la baarolu ke sariya xono.
I xa xan xa fasuwo la hooroya, sariyafango, jamano tulo a ɲa ma, a la kilinya an’a la diinolu xaaɲano.
Sariyasin 40 nanŋo : Hadamdinyakafolu s’i la baarolu ke sariyafango xono i xo sariya x’ fo ɲa men.
Sariyasin 41nanŋo : Fango si labori jamano duguxulo dula bee.
Jamano me a la duguxulo janŋo do labula no muume ; wo be ɲa men, a la boloxosariya mennu b’a yamaruyala xa duguxulo lamara, a me wolu dulu labula no.
Moxo wo moxo n’i xo x’e be do tegela Mali duguxulo la, i xa janfa jaxuba le tege Mali ma.
Sariyasin 42 : Jamano le sago be duguxulo nafulumafenŋo bee to.
Nin nafulu innu tonobolo xa xan xa ke lamininŋo lakantalisariyaw batulo xono anin bi moxolu nin sinin moxolu la nafalu xanma.
DULA III : LATEGELIFANGO {#dula-iii-:-lategelifango}
DAKUN I : JAMANAKUNTIGO {#dakun-i-:-jamanakuntigo}

Sariyasin 43 nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo le mu fango ɲamoxoba ti. Ate le be sariyajuba lakantala. Fasuwo la kilinya tigiya b’ate le bulu. Jamano la fanmahooroya, a la kilinya, jamano nin jamana xotelu la benxanŋolu topotolo tigiya b’a bulu. A s’a hakilo tu jamano marafangolu lataxamaliɲa beto la tuma bee.
Sariyasin 44 nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo le be jamano la politikitaxabulo lategela.
Sariyasin 45 nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo si sigi san luulu baara sarato xanma, wote sinfe. A la maro sarato me tanbi sinɲa fula xan xa jokki i ɲoxo la..
Sariyasin 46 nanŋo : Moxo wo moxo men be jamanaɲamoxoya ɲininna, wo tigo xa xan xa malidinŋo yerewulo ti, men na boloxosariya n’a la politikisariyaw man tiɲa. A xa xan xa ke moxo tilinnin ti.
Jamanaɲamoxoyaɲininna siyo doxoyaninba xa xan xa ke sanji 35 ti, a siyaninba xa xan xa ke sanji 75 ti xa ben a la lodulaɲininsafe bulalo ma, awa fango labaaralo barako xa xan xa k’a la.

Sariyasin 47 nanŋo : Jamanakuntigiwotelu si ke tili bi naani nin luulu kuntaxala xono (45) a dogoyaninba anin tili bi wooro kuntaxala xono (60) a siyaninba jannin peresidan sigininŋo la sigilisarato xa ban.
Sariyasin 48 nanŋo : Jama boxoba le be Peresidanŋo sugandila wote sinfe.
N’o korita xa sabati sinɲa folo to, wote kun fulananŋo si toben xa ben alahadi kun sabananŋo nata ma, men be lala wote kun folo jaabolu dilo xo, sariyajuba la kiititegebunŋo le b’o kela.

Nin, tili woronwula jannin wote kun folo xa ke, lodulaɲininna kilin sata walante barantoku x’a soto, sariyajuba kiititegebulunŋo si wote bula no waxati xote la, bari wo waxati kuto man xan xa tanbi tili tan nin luulu xan.
Lodulaɲininna fulo mennu la jama xa siya bee ta ti wote sinɲa folo to, woteku fulananŋo be tobenna wo lelu n’i ɲoxo te.
Lodulaɲininna men na jama je siyaya, wo le be sigila xa ke Peresidanŋo ti.
Nin lodulaɲininna fulo do kilin sata walante a x’e sinbo walante nin barantoku x’a soto, keno si labula moxo sabananŋo ɲen, men na jama siyata wote kun folo moxo tolu ta ti.
Nin lodulaɲinnina do sata walante barantoku x’a soto wote kun fulo te, sariyajuba kiitibulunŋo si wote bono a loxo xoto, bari a je bula waxati kuto men na, wo man xan xa tanbi tili tan nin luulu xan.
Sariyasin 49nanŋo : Sariyajuba la kiititegebunŋo le be peresidanwote keɲa beto korosila ; a si hakilijakkabo ke maxasixanŋolu xan anin xa jaabi labanŋolu fo.
Sariyasin 50 nanŋo : Tobenno mennu be kela jamanakuntigo sugandilo to, sariya le b’olu dafala.
Sariyasin 51nanŋo : Persidanŋo la baara keta nin baara sifa xote si me ben no : politikilodulalu, sugandilo xa lodula xote d’a ma, furubabaara sifa wo sifa anin nafasotosilo fen wo fen.

Sariyasin 52nanŋo : Peresidanŋo be baaro kela sarato mennu xono, a fan me a ŋanne no, walante xa moxo xote bula xa fenŋo do san a toxo la, walante xa moxo bula xa baara ke a toxo la, a be men sarala fasuwo halalakeno hukumo xono fo n’a x’a tara kiititegebunba x’o yamaruya sariya fe.

A la baaro sarato muume xono, Peresidanŋo me a bo no fan to, walante xa moxo xote bula xa fenŋo do san, walante xa moxo bula xa baara ke a si men sara xa ɲatilin fasuwo halalakeno ma. A fan, walima a me a toxolamoxo bula no x’e sindun xantobulalolu jaabilo to, furubabaaro nin kenfanɲebaarolu sabatilo hukumo xono, mennu be xarafanin fasuwo ma.
Sariyasin 53nanŋo : Nin ku xa Peresidanŋo kori a la baaro ma waxati xono, minisiriɲamoxo s’a lodula ta wo waxato xono..

Sabaabo fen wo fen je Peresidan sigidula toxulunya waxati xono, walante x’a bali pewu, walante kudayi, x’a la baaro ke, n’o kunnafirinŋo sita sariyajuba labatulibulunŋo ma, sariyatabulunŋo ɲamoxoba, sariyatabulun fulananŋo (sena) Peresidanŋo walante minisiriɲamoxo fe, a lodula si latanbi sariyatabulunŋo ɲamoxoba ma. Nin kuwo do x’o du bali, walante n’a man son, walante n’a sata, sena Peresidanŋo s’a lodula ta..

Peresidan kuto sigilo si ke tili bi xononto xono a doxoyaninba anin tili keme ni muxan xono a siyayaninba x’a ta sigidula toxulunyalo korosilo lunŋo ma, walante a balilo pewu sabaabo lonno x’a me a la baarao ke no.
Moxo men be bulala Peresidanŋo no to wo waxato xono, me ke no lodulaɲininna ti wo wote xono. Ni sigidula toxulunyata, notobulo me nin sariyajuba sariyasin 57, 60, 69, 70 anin 184 labori no..
Sariyasin 54nanŋo : Peresidan kuto men je sigi, wo s’a la baaro damuta peresidan xoto la sigilo sarato bantumo.
Sariyasin 55nanŋo : Sanni a xa baaro damuta, Peresidanŋo si nin xalixan innu ke kiititege bulunba jama ɲa la :

« Nte be n xalila Alan nin malidinŋolu bee ɲala xo n si Mali la sariyajuba nin sariyalu batu anin x’e labatu, xa n na baarolu lakanta malidinŋo bee la heerasoto xanma, xa hadamadinŋo la boloxosariyaw n’a la hooroya lakanta, xa demokarasifango lakanta, xa jamano la kilinya, a la fanmahooroya anin a la duguxulo lakanta, n je ke jamano dula wo dula, n si n fan bula jamano la bulo xan anin xa kuwo bee ke xa fatafinna jamanolu la kilinya sabati.
Nin n xa nin xalixan in sooso, n s’a ɲinin malidinŋolu fe i x’e la lannaya muta n na awa sariya xa bori n xan.».

Sariyasin 56nanŋo : Peresidan sigilo tulunŋolu banninŋo xo, xa tili woronwula dafa, Peresidan kuto s’a halaalafenŋolu dantege Jamano nafulolu segesegelikiitibunŋo ɲamoxo anin jama ɲala. Wo dantegelixanŋo si lakutaya san wo san anin n’a la sarato banninŋo.
Jamano nafulolu segesegelikiitibunŋo Peresidanŋo si jamanadinŋolu kunnafirin wo dantegelo nin lakutayalo la..
Sariyasin 57nanŋo : Peresidanŋo le be minisiriɲamoxo sugandila anin xa dan sigi a la baaro la. A si goferenaman moxo tolu sugandi minisiriɲamoxo hakilila ɲinininŋo xo awa a si dan sigi i la baaro la.
Sariyasin 58nanŋo : Minisirilu la ɲoxojo ɲamoxoya be Peresidanŋo le bulu. Minisiriɲamoxo s’a lodula fa a la yamaruya xono anin ɲoxojo sigikunŋo xan.
Sariyasin 59nanŋo : Goferenaman benta safe mennu xonokuwo xan, Persidan si wolu latege x’e ke sariyalu ti tili tan nin luulu xo, x’a damuta i dunno lunŋo ma goferenaman bulu..
N’a keta baranin ti, lategelo sarato si lasutuya no xa jigi tili sagi xoto.
Jannin nin sarati xa dafa, a s’a ɲinin sariyatabulunŋo fe a xa sariya walante xa sariyasinŋo dolu lategelixan kuta xote ta.
Ban me ke no wo lategelixan kuto talo ma anin du a si lategelo sarato den.

Sariyasin 60nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo, x’a la a fan na hakilina taninŋo xan walante sariyatabulun fulo hakilila yitaninŋo xo, sariyajuba kiitibunŋo hakilina dininŋo xo fasuwo la kunnafirinsafeba xono, si jamanadinŋolu hakilila ɲinin no wote sinfe fasuwo kunxankuwo ɲabolo, sariya bululaninŋo men be tali kela marafangow tobenno la, walante men b’a ɲininna xa benxanŋo do sabati wo men nin sariyajuba xonokuwolu nte fola i ɲoxo xo, bari n’a si tooro lasi jamano lolanŋolu ma. Nin ŋanneya innu bee si ta no Peresidanŋo fe, xa tali ke goferenaman na laɲininŋolu la, sariyatabulunŋo la ɲoxojo waxato, walante sariyatabulunŋo fan laɲininŋo to.
Nin hakililaɲininwote jaabo keta sariya talo ti, jamanakuntigo s’a latege sariyasin 59 nanŋo sarati bululaninŋolu xono.
Sariyasin 61nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo si jamano lahalaya dantege xumafota xono, depitelu ɲen, i la ɲoxoje bululaninŋo sinfe sanŋo xono sinɲa kilin.

Sariyasin 62nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo nin sariyatabulunba fulo Peresidanŋolu s’i ɲoxo xumaɲoxoya xibarusafelu la, a be peresidan fulo bulala xa mennu xaran. Sariyatabulunba ni sena s’i ɲoxotara wo hukumo xono x’a tara a man ke sigili yamauyanin ti.
Sariyasin 63nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo le mu kelefangolu nin lakantalifangolu ɲamoxoba ti. A be jamano la lakantakafo anin jamano la lafasalikomite la ɲoxojolu ɲamoxoya tala..

Jamanakuntigo le be jamanadinŋolu la lawulilo yamaruyala anin fasudinŋolu sindunno keɲalu pereperelategelo fasuwo lafasalo to n’a x’a tara jamano be lahalaya men xono lakantalo silatego la, wo b’o wajibiyanin.
Sariyasin 64nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo le mu kiititegelalu la ɲamoxoba ti.
Sariyasin 65nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo si yaafo sabati no kasoladinŋolu ɲen. A si kelebanŋo sariyalu yita.
Sariyasin 66nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo s’a buluno bula yamaruyasafelu nin waleyasafelu la, mennu tata minisirilu la ladalaɲoxojo sinfe.
Sariyasin 67nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo si moxolu sugandi fasuwo la baaradalu anin sorodasibulolu ɲamoxolu lodula xanma.

Fasuwo la jalalu marabaxo, sorodaasolu la jalatigibalu, fasuwo la lasigidinŋolu, fasuwo la kiiladin xerexereninŋolu, maraɲamoxolu anin fasuwo la baaradalu ɲamoxo, ninnu bee be sigila minisirilu la ɲoxojeba la waleyalisafe le fe.
Moxolu be sugandila x’a la i la nokuwolu, i la lonŋolu anin i la ladiriya xan..
Sariyasin 68 nanŋo : Peresidanŋo le be jamano la lasigidinŋolu an’a la kiiladinŋo xerexereninŋolu sugandila, x’e bula xa taxa jamana xote xono.
Sariyasin 69nanŋo : Peresidanŋo keninma xo xa sariyatabulun fulo Peresidanŋolu xumaɲoxoya, a si sariyatabulunŋo telo latege no.
Sariyatabulunŋo telo me latege no a sigininŋo xaru tan nin fula folo xono, fo n’a yitata xo xoyilisafe do si muta no.
Wotelu si ke tili tan wooro xono a doxoyaninba walante tili keme nin muxan xono a siyaninba sariyatabulunŋo telo xo.
Sanŋo men be lanin wotelu xan, sariyatabulunŋo me te no wo xono.
Sarato men be pereperelategenin nin sariyasin in silakun sabananŋo xono, n’o sarato dafata, x’a tara wotelu man ke, sariyatabulun teninŋo si lassagi a la baarolu ma.

Sariyasin 70 nanŋo: N’a x’a tara jamano losinŋolu, jamano la fanmahooroya, jamano duguxulo dafaninŋo, saratixanba bulunobulaninŋo lawaleyalo xoleyata ɲajaxu ma anin tariya to anin n’a x’a tara jamano fangabundalu lataxamaɲa xoleyata, Peresidanŋo si sariya xerexereninnu ta nin lahalaha innu xa mennu wajibiya, minisiriɲamoxo, sariyatabulunŋo ɲamoxoba nin sena ɲamoxoba ani sariyajuba la kiititegebulunŋo Peresidanŋo.
A si xibarusafe do ke xa jamanadinŋolu kunnafirin.
Sariya x’a yita xo sariyatabulunba xonomoxolu s’i ɲoxoje.
Persidanŋo la nin fanga xerexerenin innu waleyalo man xan xa fe bula jamano la hooroya anin jamano duguxulo dafalo la.
Fanga xerexereninŋolu xa xan xa ɲataxo lasabati, sarati sutun xono, xa jamano losinŋolu lataxamalo sabati waxato bee, xa tali ke sariyajuba la.
Fanga xerexereninŋolu la waleyalo kuntaxo xono, jamano losin si me te no walante xa den.
Feere mennu nin sariya be tali kela i ɲoxo la n’i tata fanga xerexereninŋolu waleyalo waxato, si ke no fu ti nin sariyatabulunŋo m’e latege, tili tan xononto sarato xono i yamaruyaninŋo xo.

Sariyasin 71 nanŋo : Peresidanŋo s’a la lodula dolu di no minisiriɲamoxo ma. Peresidanŋo la kewalolu, mennu man ta ba la sariyasin 57, 60, 65, 69 et 70 nanŋo xono anin silakun folo folo xono, minisiriɲamoxo buluno si kafu persidanŋo ta xan fe, walante minisirilu xotelu s’i buluno a la a be mennu kunŋo xan.
Sariyasin 72 : Persidanŋo nin fenŋo mennu xa xan,, sariya x’olu dantege, awa a si tofoɲolixaliso du sotolo toben Peresidan xotoninŋolu, fe man bula mennu la boloxosariyalu la ɲen.
Sariyasin 73 : Peresidanŋo la jamanakuntigiya waxato xono, a si nomuta no kewalo dolu to, mennu si jaate no janfa jaxuba ti jamano ma..
Sariyatabulunŋo s’a lodula muta no a la x’a sabaabo ke janfa jaxuba ti.
Nin Peresidanŋo x’a la xalixanŋo sooso, a si fo wo ma xo janfa jaxuba.
Xoyilisafe hakilila be tala sariyatabulunŋo do kilin ne fe. A me muta no fo n’a x’a tara sariyatabulunŋo xonomoxolu talaninŋo saba ti, tala fulo x’e buluno bula a to.

A be sariyatabulunŋo men kunwo xan, wo s’ a lasi baarabulu lafaamuyaninŋo ma; wo si segesegelolu nin lameeli nafama sifa bee ke, wolu mennu sinfe, a s’a hakila di, nin xoyilisafe si muta no walante n’a me muta no.
Nin baarabulo x’a yita xo xoyilisafe me muta no, a kuwo si dabula..
Nin baarabulo x’a yita xo tanbi si ke no a kuwo fe, a si jalagilisafe dara x’a bula sariyatabulunŋo jama boxoba la xan sotoninŋo wote xono.

Nin son keta jalagilisafe ma, a si lasi sariyatabulunŋo fulananŋo ma, tili sagi sarato xono, awa a xa xan x’a hakilila di foɲa kilinnu ma tili tan nin luulu sarato xono. Nin man ke jalagilisafe ma, xoyiloxumo si bula.
Nin sariyatabulun fulo benta a to xa jalagilisafe latege, wo si bange fango la suturo bolo ti jamanakuntigo xan.
Sariyatabulun fulo s’i ɲoxotara ɲoxojeba do to, xa hakilijakkabo ke Peresidanŋo xoyilikuwo to. Xoyilo be lategela sariyatabulunŋo xonomoxolu talaninŋo naani te, wo tala sabo le fe.
Depite mennu sonta xoyilo ma, wo lelu la wote be jaatela.
Ɲoxotara mennu be kela, kiititegebulunba labanŋo le b’olu ɲamoxoya tala.
Lafasalo boloxosariyalu be jamanakuntigo bulu. A s’a diyaɲenmoxo do ta no x’a fan deema, taxabulo dakunŋo bee to.
Lataxamasariya si nin sariyasin in waleyaɲalu pereperelatege.
Sariyasin 74 nanŋo: Jamanakuntigo si ɲangi no furubasariya kiititegebunŋolu fe, n’a xa sariyasoosolu ke a la fango waxato xono.

A keta ɲa wo ɲa, Peresidanŋo me wajibiya no xa ke seede ti, kewale me labori no a xan, a me wajibiya no xa kunnafirin ɲinin a fe, a me nomuta no f’a la sarato xa ban. Ɲangilisarato nin foɲoxonxosarato bee si den.
A lodula tun be kenin x’a la nomutakuwolu bali, wolu bee si lawuli a nofe xaru kilin a la fangobulo xo.
DAKUN II : GOFERENAMAN {#dakun-ii-:-goferenaman}
Sariyasin 75nanŋo : Goferenaman xonomoxolu mu : minisiriɲamoxo nin minisirilu. Lataxamasariya si goferenama xonomoxo haxxo latege.
Sariyasin 76 nanŋo: Goferenaman si jamano taxabulo baaro ke, Peresidanŋo xa men pereperelatege. Maro b’ate le bulu.
Sariyasin 77nanŋo : Minisiriɲamoxo mu goferenaman ɲamoxo ti. Wo xanma a si goferenaman na baaro ɲakunya ta.
A si sariya lawaleya. N’a bota sariyasin 66 nin 67 nanŋo tobennolu ma, a si sariyalafango labori.
A s’a lodula dolu di no minisirilu ma.
A si persidanŋo notobula no minisirilu la ɲoxojo sinfe yamaruya xono, anin ɲoxojo kun lategeninŋo.
A s’a notobula jamano lakantalikafo anin jamano lafasalikafo la ɲoxojo persidanya la..
Minisiriɲamoxo la baarolu si bulunobula minisirilu fe mennu xa xan x’e waleya.
Sariyasin 78 nanŋo : Goferenaman moxolu be ɲafoli Peresidanŋo le ɲen.
Sariyasin 79nanŋo : Goferenaman xonomoxolu s’i la nafulolu dantegelisafe di jamano nafulolu segesegelikiitibunŋo ma tili tan saba sarato xono i sugandininŋo xo.
Jamano la nafulolu segesegelikitibunŋo Peresidanŋo si jamanadinŋo lalon wo kewalo anin lakutayalolu la.
Sariyasin 52 nanŋo tobennolu si waleya goferenaman xonomoxolu xan.

Sariyasin 80 nanŋo : Minisiriɲamoxo si goferenaman na baara ketalu dantege sariyatabulunŋo xonomoxolu ɲen. Wo dantegelo si ke sariyatabulun fulo xonomoxolu bee ɲen tili tan saba a siyaninba, Peresidanŋo la dantegelo xo jamano lahalaya xan. Hakilifalinfalinŋolu si ke wo xan men be bangela laɲininŋolu la x’a tara wote man ke.
Sariyasin 81nanŋo : Minisiriya lodula nin nin baara innu me ben no : depiteya, baarabulo ɲamoxoya, xa ɲatilin fasuwo ma, walante sigida do ma, furubabaarada walante nafasotobaaro sifa wo sifa.
Sariyasin 82 nanŋo : Minisirilu si ɲangi no sariyatiɲawalolu to mennu je ke a la minisiriya waxato xono.
Santokiitibunŋo le be nomutalo kela. Sariya be tegela kiitibun innu fe mennu be borila fasudinŋo bee xan.
Men mu kiito to ti, kiitibunŋo la ɲininxalolu anin kiititego, ɲangilisariyajuwo tobennolu si waleya..
DAKUN III : MARO {#dakun-iii-:-maro}
Sariyasin 83nanŋo : Furubanafabaaro je ke sifa wo sifa ti, maro s’olu ke x’a la baaradalu sigikunŋolu xan..

Sariyasin 84nanŋo: Maro si soto, hadamadinya nin lonkuwo yiriwalo sannayelo ke x’a ben jamano sigidalakulonninŋolu nafabobaxolu haajolu ma, tilinnya, hadamadinŋo la boloxosariyalu nin sariyafango batulo xan.
Sariyasin 85 nanŋo : Maro baarakelalu i la baaro xono, be wajibiyanin xa furubabaaro lataxalisariyalu batu n’olu mu sariyalataxamo, xaaɲano anin dantekuto anin kuntaxala xono.
I xa xan xa keɲalu ta mennu be tali kela dunatotego keɲa nin jigo betolu sariyalu batulo la, xerexereninya la, dafaninya, tilinninya anin ladiriya.
Sariyasin 86 nanŋo : Jamano si feere tege, men s’a tu maro baarakelalu talo xa ke tilinninya xono n’o be bee xaaɲana anin x’e la baaro kuntaxo sinsin baaro lonno dalilolu xan.
Sariyasin 87nanŋo : Jamano si baaro, sarakuwo nin lakantalo lahalayalu di maro baarakelalu ma, wolu mennu s’a tu i la baaro si ke a ɲa ma..
DAKUN IV : FANMARA MARAFANGOLU. {#dakun-iv-:-fanmara-marafangolu.}

Sariyasin 88 nanŋo : Fanmara marafangolu s’i la baarolu ke, xerexereninya la foxabenŋo, sotobaarolu waleyalisariyalu, segesegelo nin korosilo, hooroyalu nin hadamadinŋolu la boloxosariyalu lakantalo, wotelu tobenno n’i topotolo hukumo xono. .
Fanmara marafangolu sigita sariya le fe.
DAKUN V : SORODAASOLU NIN LAKANTALO KEBAXOLU ; {#dakun-v-:-sorodaasolu-nin-lakantalo-kebaxolu ;}
Sariyasin 89 nanŋo : Sorodaasolu nin lakantalo kebaxolu la baaro mu jamano duguxulo dafaninŋo lafasalo, hadamadinŋolu n’i bulufenŋolu lakantalo, basigo sabatilo anin sariyalu waleyalo ti.
I si yiriwalo, hadamadinya, lonkuwo anin jamano lamininŋo lakantalo yiriwalibaarolu ke.
Sariyasin 90 : Sorodaasolu nin lakantalikelalu be jamano la maro le xono. Benxanfangatigo lelu mu, politikimoxolu nte awa a be baaro kela politifango la maro xono.
Sariyasin 91nanŋo : Jamano sorodaasolu me bula no basigibaaro la fo nin sariya x’e yamaruya.
Sariyasin 92nanŋo : Jamano sorodaasolu n’a lakantabaxolu si bula no xa basigibaarolu ke jamano xo xan, Mali la saratixanba taninŋolu batulo hukumo xono.
Sariyasin 93nanŋo : Fango la korosilo si bori jamano sorodaasolu n’a la lakantabaxolu xan tuma bee, ɲa men do si kafu kelekebaxolu ma anin xa baarakemiranŋolu d’i ma i la baarolu waleyalo xanma.
DULA IV : SARIYATAFANGO {#dula-iv-:-sariyatafango}
DAKUN I : TOBENNIBALU {#dakun-i-:-tobennibalu}
Sariyasin 94nanŋo : Sariyatafango be labaarala depite lelu fe..
Sariyatabulunŋo le be sariyalu tala wote sinfe anin xa goferenaman la baaraketalu xiime.
Sariyasin 95nanŋo : Sariyatabulunŋo mu sifa fula ti : sariyatabulunba folo (depitelu) nin sariyatabulun fulananŋo (senaterilu). .
Ɲoxojeba (Kongere) mu sariyabulun fulo la ɲoxotaro le ti. Ɲoxojeba ɲamoxoya be sariyatabulunba Peresidanŋo le bulu, a ɲamoxo lanxanŋo si ke sena la Peresidanŋo ti.
Sariyasin 96 : A si fo sariyatabulunba xonomoxolu ma xo depitelu.
Depitelu be sugandila san luulu le xanma wotekelalu fannu la wote sinfe.
Malidinŋo mennu be jamano xo xan, wolu toxolamoxolu si ke sariyatabulunba xono bari wo keɲalu be lategenin sariya le fe.
Sariyasin 97nanŋo : A si fo sena xonomoxolu ma xo senaterilu.

Marabulolu la moxo sugandininŋo lelu moxo dolu be tala sena xono ; N’i xa sena xonomoxolu tala sigidula naani ti, talaku saba si ke marabulu la moxo sugandinŋolu ti. Tala naaninanŋo si ke gallutigolu nin laadalamoxolu, malidinŋo mennu be siginin jamano xo xan anin moxoba mennu xa bunya soto x’a la i la baara keninŋolu to.
Sena moxolu la sigilisarato mu sanji luulu le ti.
Sariyasin 98 nanŋo : Moxo kilin me depite lodula ni senateri lodula ta no.
Sariyasin 99 nanŋo : sariya le be depitelu sugandiɲa pereperelategela. Ale du be senaterilu sugandiɲa pereperelategela.

Sariyasin 100nanŋo : Lataxamasariya le be sariyatabulun fula in sugandilo, sugandilibaliyalu nin benbaliyalu keɲalu pereperelategela. Ate le du be i notobulo keɲalu pereperelategela nin lodula toxulunyata.
Sariyasin 101 nanŋo : Lataxamasariya si depitelu ni senaterilu la sotolu n’i la nafalu lategela.
Sariyasin 102nanŋo : I sigininŋo xo tili tan saba sarato xono, depitelu nin senaterilu s’i la nafulolu dantege jamano nafulo segesegelikiitibunba Peresidanŋo ɲen.
Nin dantegeli innu ni baara bulolu si lakutaya san wo san.
Jamano nafulo segesegelikiitibunba Peresidanŋo si jamanadinŋolu kunnafirin wo dantegelo n’o lakutayalo la.

Sariyasin 103nanŋo : Depitelu nin senaterilu me sutura no fo n’a keta i la baaro xonola ti. Sariya s’i nomuta du, x’e ɲininxa, x’e muta, x’e dun kaso la, x’e kiiti xo sabaabo ke i hakilalu walante i la wote keninŋolu sariyatabulunŋo la ɲoxojolu sinfe.

Sariyasin 104 nanŋo : Depite wo depite walante senateri wo senateri, men je ɲangi moxofaxo to, wo tigo la depiteya walante a la senateriya si ban sariya Minisiri fe. Wo be ɲa men, latilinniɲangilo si la depite walante senateri xan, men kuntaxala mu san kilin walante san kilin nin do ti, sariyalayaafa nte men to.
Sariyasin 105 nanŋo: Sugandilo waxati haxxo wajibiyaninŋo mu fu le ti.
Depitelu la wote boloxosariyalu mu moxo kilin wo kilinna haxxo le ti. Lataxamasariya si notobulawote yamaruya xerexereninya la. Wo to, moxo si me yamaruya soto no xa wote moxo xote no to.
Sariyasin 106 nanŋo : Depite wo depite walante senateri wo senateri, n’i bot’e la politikitonŋo to, walante a be kafo men kufonin, wo tigo la depiya si ban.
Safelo le be sinbolo yitala. Partiton xote walante kafu xote todunno nin sinbolo bee kilin..
Depite walante senateri sinboninŋo a fan ma, si notobula xa tali ke lataxamasariya lahalayalu la.
DAKUN II : SARIYATABULUNŊO LATAXAMALO {#dakun-ii-:-sariyatabulunŋo-lataxamalo}
Sariyasin 107 nanŋo : Sariyatabulunba nin sena s’i ɲoxoje, wajibo la, sigili bululanin fula to sanŋo xono..
Sigili folo si damuta okutoburuxaro tenen folo. . A kuntaxo me siya no tili tan woronwula nin luulu ti..
Sigili fulananŋo si damuta awirilixaro tenen folo awa a kuntaxala me siya no tili tan xononto ti.

Sariyasin 108nanŋo : sariyatabulunba si ɲoxojo ke sigili barantoninŋo xono ; wo si ke nin jamanakuntigo x’a laɲinin, walante ni depitelu walante senaterilu boxoba x’a laɲini, ɲoxojekun mategeninŋo do xan..
N’a keta sigili barantonin ti, kunfaxalo waleyalisafe si ta nin sariyatabulunba xa sigilo sigikunŋo xonokuwolu ban, i kilita men na ; wo si ke tili tan nin luulu, x’a damuta a sigilo kililunŋo ma. .
Sariyasin 109nanŋo : N’a man ke ɲoxoje bululanin ti, Peresidanŋo si waleyalisafe ke xa ɲoxoje barantoninŋolu dayele anin xe kunfaxa.
Sariyasin 110nanŋo : Depite walante senateri be wajibiyanin x’e sindun baarabulolu la baarolu nin ɲafololibaarolu to, n’o nte sariyatabulunba ni sena lataxamasariyalu s’a ɲangi.
Sariya 111nanŋo : Sariyatabulunŋo kilin wo kilin s’a la lataxamasariya sigi. Ɲoxojeba la lataxamasariya be sigila sariyatabulun fulo le fe.
Sariyasin 112 nanŋo: Sariyatabulunba Peresidanŋo nin sena Peresidanŋo be sigila san luulu le xono .
Sariyasin 113nanŋo : Sariyatabulunba Peresidanŋo nin sena Peresidanŋo lodula si muta no i la, n’i me la baara ketalu ke a ɲa ma.
Xoyilisafe me muta fo n’a x’a tara sariyatabulunŋo tala fulo tala saba to, x’e buluno bula a la.
Xoyilifeere si me miiriya no sariyatabulunŋo Peresidanŋo walante sena Peresidanŋo sigininŋo san fula.
A be sariyatubulunŋo me kunxan, wo xonomoxolu jama boxoba, n’o jama talaku saba ti talaku naani to, le be xoyilo lategela, bari wo be kela xonotosariya le fe.

N’a keta xoyiliku ti, sariyatabulunba Peresidanŋo walante sena Peresidanŋo si peresidan kuto sigi xa tali ke xonotosariya la keɲa mategeninŋolu la. Persidan kuto si peresidan xoyininŋo la sigisarato do dafa.
Sariyasin 114 : Bee si taxa no sariyatabulun fulo la sigilolu to. Bari, a s’a ŋanneya no a la sigilo xa ke a gullo to, nin peresidan x’o laɲinin. Xonotosariya s’o keɲalu latege.
Hakilifalinfalinŋolu ɲafolliba si safe jamano la kunnafirinsafeba xono.
DAKUN III : SARIYA NIN TAXABULO HUKUMO {#dakun-iii-:-sariya-nin-taxabulo-hukumo}
Sariyasin 115 nanŋo : Sariya be wotela jama boxoba doxomandinŋo le fe.
Fasudinya boloxosariyalu anin jamanadinŋolu be boloxosariya mennu nafa bola, xa ɲatilin jama la hooroya ma, lakantalo men be ɲatilinnin jamanadinŋolu ma an’i halalafenŋolu.
Jamano la lafasalo xa hakililayito mennu wajibiya fasudinŋolu xan, wolu mu :

fasudinya, fasudinya boloxosariyalu, hadamadinŋolu lahalayalu n’i nokuwolu, kore taxabulo, notobulalolu, tigiya taxabulo, boloxosariya jonjonŋolu nin jaagukuwo la ku wajibiyaninŋolu, kafolu taxabulo, mutannalolu ;
Ɲangilo mennu be borila sariyatiɲalu (moxofaxolu, boyixannolu…), kiito taxabulo, kiititegela deemabaxolu (polisolu), moxo borininŋo lasaagilo, yaafo, kiitititegebunŋolu lolo, kiititegebaarolu ;
Furubabaarakelalu kilin wo kilin be bulo men xan ;
Sorodaasolu nin lakantalikelalu kilin wo kilin be bulo men xan. ;
Sariyatigo kilin wo kilin be bulo men xan ;
Santoxaranbunŋo lekolikaramoxo ɲininnikelalu be bulo men xan ;
baara kilin kelalu la tonŋo ;
lafasalo nin lakantalo tobenɲalu ;
baaro boloxosariya, hadamadinŋo lakantalo boloxosariya, lafasalotonŋo boloxosariya ;
Fasuwo lonkuwo n’a nokuwo an’a la fen xotolu ;
Musaaxolu nin sotolu jaatebolo ;
Furubabaaradalu dayelelo, i tobenno an’i korosilo ;
kenfanɲo baaradalu bulalo jamano la bulo xan, jamano furuba halalabaaradalu bolo jamano la bulo xan anin i la yelemalo kenfanɲo la bulo xan. ;
jamano duguxulo topotolo n’a mutalo ;
Nafulukuwo sariya si fango la sotolu n’a la kundonolu latege lataxamasariya hukumo xono.
Bululasariyalu si jamano la soto, a la hadamadinya, a la lonkuwo anin lakantalo kuntilinnalu latege..
Sariyasin 116 nanŋo : Sariya man kewalo mennu kufo, wolu bee si jaate no sariya xonofenŋo ti.
Sariyasafe mennu tata x’a tara nin sariyajuba in man wote, Peresidanŋo si wo yelema no waleyalisafe la, santokiititegebunba la yamaruya xono.
Nin sariya in mennu waleyalo je damuta nin sariyajuba in sigilo xo, waleyasafe me wolu me yelema no fo n’a x’a tara sariyajuba x’a yita xo tobenninbexanŋo lelu mu.
Sariyalu nin taxabulolu si gansi fasuwo la kunnafirindisafe xono.
Sariyasin 117 nanŋo : Depite lelu be yamaruyanin xa kelo lategelixumo fo ɲoxojeba xerexereninŋo sinfe, bari jama boxoba le b’o lategela.
Jamanakuntigo si jamanadinŋolu lalon xibarusafe do fe.
Sariyasin 118 : Fango la waxatilakorosilo nin jamanadalasigo latego be tala minisirilu la ɲoxojo le sinfe.
Do kafulo i ma, xa tanbi tili tan nin luulu la, be yamaruyala saritabulunba xonooxo boxoba le fe. Sariya s’o keɲalu latege.
DAKUN IV : XA ƝATILIN TESILOLU MA MENNU BE WALEYALIFANGO NIN SARIYATAFANGO TE {#dakun-iv-:-xa-ɲatilin-tesilolu-ma-mennu-be-waleyalifango-nin-sariyatafango-te}
Sariyasin 119 nanŋo : Jamanakuntigo nin sariyatabulunŋo xonomoxolu lelu be kafula xa sariyalu hakilina tala.
Hakilifalinfalinŋo be kela sariya mennu xan, wolu be lategela minisirilu la ɲoxojo le sinfe, santokiititegebunŋo la hakilina dininŋo xo, wo xo, i si ki sariyatabulun fula in do kilin na biro ma.
Nafulukuwo sariyalu porose be yitala folo, sariyatabulunŋo le la.

Sariya porose mennu kuntilinnalu mu duguxulo tobenno ti, sigidalakulonninŋolu taxabulo, galutigolu nin laadalamoxobalu taxabulolu, anin sariya porose mennu be tali kela lamininŋo nin malidinŋolu xan, mennu be jamano xo xan, be dantegela sena moxo lelu folo ɲen.
Sariyatabulun fulo la ɲoxojo kunŋo be lategela goferenaman ne fe x’a damuta sariya porose hakilifalinfalinŋo ma xa tax’a bula sariya dantegeninŋolu

Sariyasin 120 nanŋo : Sariytabulunŋo xonomoxolu nin goferenaman be yelemalo kelo yamaruyanin b’olu bulu n’o si ke sigili keno xan walima baarabulolu xono, xa tali ke sariyatabulun fulo la xonotosariyalu la.
Hakilifalinfalinŋolu damutaninŋo xo, goferenaman si bann no yelemo bee segesegelo ma, mennu man yitala xa xoto.

Sariyasin 121 nanŋo : Goferenaman la baara bululaninŋo waleyalo xanma, a si yamaruya ɲinin no sariyatabulunba fe , xa feerelu ta, sarati dansigininŋo xono, mennu be sariya hukumo xono, yamaruyasafe la.

Yamaruyasafe mennu tata minisirilu la ɲoxojo sinfe, santokiitibunŋo hakilila ɲininno xo waleyalo si damuta n’i lategeta, bari i si ke fuwo ti nin sariya porose senbentiyata man bula sariyatabulunŋo la bulo xan sannin waxati lategeninŋo te sariya fe. Sarato men be safenin nin sariyasin silakun folo xono n’o sarato tanbita, yelema me dun no yamaruyasafelu to fo n’a keta sariyalu ti.

Sariyasin 122 nanŋo : Nin goferenaman x’a laɲinin, dantegelo men keta, sariyatabulunŋo s’a hakilina di wote sinfe sariyasafe fesefeseta xan, bari yelemo mennu yitata walante son keta mennu ma goferenaman fe, wo lelu be tala.

Dantegelo nin yelemo mennu keta sariyatabulunŋo moxolu fe, wolu muta no n’i lategelo ɲanfinŋo si ke furubasotolu doxoyalo ti walante furubamusaaxolu sigilo walante i jaxuyalo ti, fo n’a x’a tara nin dantegeli innu walante yelemolu nte tali kela sotolu la.

N’a korosita xo sariyalu safetumo, dantegelo walante yelemo nte sariya hukumo xono, goferenaman s’i ban no a mutabaliya ma. N’a keta benbaliya ti, gofereman nin sariyatabulunŋo te a dantegeta men na, sariyatajuba si hakilifalifalinŋo k’a xan tili sagi sarato xono, goferenaman walante sariyatabulunŋo peresidanŋo la laɲininŋo xono.
Sariyasin 123 nanŋo : Porose fen wo fen, sariya walante dantegelo si fesefese sariyatabulun fulo fe a sariya ɲoxon lategelo xanma.
Hakilifalinfalinŋo mennu be kela sariya poroselu xan, sariyatabulun folo la, sariya yitaninŋ xan goferenaman fe.
Nin sariya lategeninŋo lasita sariyatabulunŋo do ma, sariyatabulunŋo to kilinŋo fe, si sariya latege men nasita a ma.

Nin foɲoxoxo dunta sariyatabulun fulo te, porose do walante sariya yitaninŋo man latege, a xaranno xo sariyatabulun fulo fe walante nin goferenaman x’a yita xo a kuwo xa tari, a xaranninŋo xo sinɲa fula sariyatabulun fulo fe walante nin goferenaman x’a yita x’a kuwo xa tari, a xaranninŋo sinɲa kilin i kilinkilinna fe, minisiriɲamoxo si baarakebulo do la ɲoxojo do bulula no men xa xan wo sariya ɲoxon dantege tobenni tolu xan.
Baarakebulo la sariya safeninŋo si dantege no goferenaman fe lategelo xanma sariyatabulun fulo la. Yelema fuyi me dunno nin sariya to fo nin goferenaman sonta a ma.

Nin baarakebulo korita furubasariya lategela walante nin wo sariya man latege i xo silakun labanŋo x’a fo ɲa men, goferenaman si, sariyatabulunŋo nin sena kenima x’a xaranku fulananŋo ke, a ɲinin sariyatabulunŋo fe xa lategeli labanŋo ke.

Maada 1 : Yixlag killu əlMaliyyiin wo yiẓiluun ahraar wo mutasaawiin vil huquug wo əlwaajibaat yihazir eyi temyiiz ɤalaa asaas aṣli ijtimaaɤiyye u əlmanṭiga u lown u luga u ɤirg u jins u diin u raayi siyaasiyə.
Maada 2 : muqadas wo maṣun. Li killu fard əlhag vil hayaat wo əlhuriyye amni wo silm šaxsiye.
Maada 3 : Taqfil dowla himaya tufeyl min tijaara bilbašar wo jiraa-in mumaaʂala wo min inxiraaṭ vi jamaaɤaat mutaṭariva ɤaniiva.
Maada 4 : Ma yimkin ixḍaaɤi had litaɤaziib wo ɤubudiyye wo muɤaamala insaaniye wol qisaasiya wolmaḥiina
Ey fard ey wokil liwilaaya muzalib bi-irtiqaab miʂl hay afɤaal, imma bi mubaadara minḥe u binaaye ɤalaa taɤliimaat, sayiɤaaʕib wivgan lišariiɤa.
Maada 5 : Ma yimkim wajib had ɤala nafyi.
Yimkin li eyi raaʕij yitɤaraḍ li-ijṭiḥaad bisabab muɤtaqid siyaasiyya u diiniyya u abudiyya li-istifaada min hag lujuu-ɤi vi jumhuriyya Mali.
Maada 6 : Likillu raagij yirfad litadbir min al hirman min al huriyya alhag vi ɤan yafhasu ṭobib min ixtiyaari.
Ma yimkin ihtijaaz killu raagij limuda tazwiid ɤan ʂamaani wo ărbaɤiin waqata illa bi qaraar musabab min qaadi ṣulh bi amri qaḍaa-iyyi.
Ma yimkin ihtijaaz killu raagij vi biniya ṣilaahiyya illa bi amri min qaḍi tahqiig bi amri qaḍaa-i.
Maada 7 : Li killu insan hag vi muhaakama ɤadila wo iṣdar hukum xilal fatra zamaniyya maɤguula.
əlhag vi difaaɤi, bime vi zalik əlhag vi istiɤaana bi muhaam min ixtiyaar raagij, makful munz tahqiig luuley.
Yiɤtabar keemil mutaḥamin abriyaa-i illa lihe tisabit idaanathum min gibal mahkama muxtaṣa.
Ălam šaxsiyi. Ma yimkin miqaadaat killu raagij u towgiv u towjiih it-ham illeh illa bimuujib šariiɤa saadir saabig afɤaal əlmansuuba ileyhi.
Maada 8 : Killu ma la yizaʑir šariiɤa maa yimkin manɤu wo ma yimkin wojib had ɤala viɤl maa la yiɤmur bih.
Maada 9 : Taxayam wo əl-usra, illi yišakila asaas ṭobiɤi lil-hayaat vi əlmujtama’ă, tahmih hume dowla wo taṭwir hume.
Taxayam hiye ithad beyn raajil wo limraă.
Maada 10 : Taɤlim wo tadrib wo šaʕal wa sakan wo tarfi wo ṣiha wo himaaya ijtimaaɤiyye wol ăyš wo xaalig ɤala lmeă killuhe huquuq muɤtariv bihe.
Maada 11 : Likillu mwaaṭin haq vi taɤlim. Taɤlim ɤam ilzami wo majaani wo laa-ɤiki. Taɤlim xaaṣ muɤtariv bihe wo yimaris wivqan lišuruuṭ illi yihadid he əšariyya.

Maada 12 : Ma yimkin imtiḥaq hirmat əlmaskan wo milk əlxas wolhayaat əlxas wol ɤa-iliyya wo bayaanaat šaxṣiyya wo siriyya əlmuraasilaat wol-ixtiṣaasat. Ma yimkin intihakihe illa wivqan min šuruuṭ əlmanguula ɤaleyhe vi šariiɤa.
Maada 13 : Hag milkiyya makfuula. Ma yimkin illa asbaab tetaɤalag bilmanfaɤa aama wo mugaabil taɤawiid ɤaadil wo musabig.
Maada 14 : Li killu insan hag vi huriyya əlvigra wo wijdan wo diin wo ibaada wo raɤayi wo klam ihtiraman bi šariɤa.
Maada 15 : Huriya ṣahaafa wo hag vi əlwuṣul ila maɤlumaat muɤtarav bihe wo maḍmuuna. Tumaris wivqa əššuruut illi yihadidḥe əššariɤa.
Maada 16 : Huriya axbaar fanni wo ʂaqaafi muɤtarav bihe wo makfuula. Tumaaris wivqa əššuruut illi.
Maada 17 : Tuɤtaraf dowla wo tadman, Bimuujib šuruut illi yihad-ha əššariɤa, huriyya giyaas wol iyaab wo huriyya ixtiyar balad igaama wo huriyya taɤdiil jemɤiyaat, wo tajemaɤ, wo taẓaahar.
Maada 18 : Hag vi šagal wo raaha muɤtariv bihi wo mutsaawiɤ likillu.
Ma yimkin waajib ayi raagij ɤala ḍir šagal muɤayan ille vi haala ḍir xidma istisnaa-iyyya lilmaslaha ɤaama, ɤala qidam musaawaat likillu, wivqan lišuruut illi yihadid-he šariiyya.
Maada 19 : huriya taɤdiil jemɤiyyaat makfuula. Tumaaris naqaabaat ɤummaliiyye ɤanšiṭat-he bila qeyd maahu tilka almanguula vi šariɤa.
Maada 20 : Hag iḍraab makfuul. Tumaaris vi iṭaar šariɤaat wo ănẓima maɤmuul bihe.
Maada 21 : Huriyyat šagle makfuulat vi iṭaar šariɤaat wo ănẓima maɤmuul.
Maada 22 : Likillu insan hag vi bi-ă ṣihiyya wo mustadaama.
Maada 23 : Killu mwaatin wo killu raagij yiɤiš ɤala turaab maliyye waajib ihtiraam Dustuur vi killu zuruuf.
Maada 24 : Difaaɤ ɤanil woṭan waajib ɤala killu mwaaṭin.
Yimkin hašdi killu əlmwaatiniin illi hum tablog qădru 18 sane u yasir jinban ila jinbbi maɤa quwaat əlmusaha wo quwaat amni li difaaɤi ɤanil Waṭan.
Maada 25 : Himaaya lbi-ă wo zeyna now-ɤiyya əlhayaat waajib ɤala killu mwaaṭin wo ɤala Dowla.
Maada 26 : Vi haala huqu xaariʂa, ɤala killu mwaaṭin waajib tagdiim awn musaaɤada wivqa šuruut illi yihadid-he əššariɤa.
Maada 27 : Yijib ɤala killu lmwaaṭinin ḍir waajibaat hum əlmadaniyyye, w laasiyam wivaa’i biwaajibaatihum əlmaaliyya.
Maada 28 : ɤala killu mwaaṭin waajib šagla min sabab ṣaalih ɤam wo ihtiraam ṣaalih ɤam wo himaayatih.
Maada 29 : Yijib ɤala killu lmwaaṭinin bi muḥima ɤaama u mas-uul ɤan waẓiifa ɤaama u muḥima xidma ɤaama yiḍirhe bi ḍomir wo wulaa-i wo istiqaama.
ƔUNWAAN II : DOWLA WO SIYAADA
Maada 30 : Mali jumhuriyyya mustakila wo mulli siyaada wo muwahada wo maahu gaabila litagassem wo dimoqraṭiyya wo laa-ikiyya wo ijtimaa-iyya.
Mabda-ăhe huwe hukm Šaɤb, min gibal Šaɤb wo mulli Šaɤb.
ɣaṣima Jumhuriyya Mali hiye Bamako. Yimkin naglihe ila eyi balad aaxar vi araaḍi əlwoṭoniyye bi muujib šariɤa.
Šiɤaar lwoṭoni huwe ɤalam bi əlwaan ʂalaaʂa mukawana bi ʂalaaʂa šaraa-iṭ ɤamudiyya wo mutsaawiyya bil xuwar wo zaḥab wol xumar.
Wo ši-ar jumḥuriya hiye : « Šaɤb wahid – Niyye wahid – ɤaqiida wahida ».
Ginaaya woṭoni hiye : « Mali ».
əŠšariɤa yihadid xaatim əLjumhuriyya, wo šiɤaarihe, wo yihadid šuruuṭ wo ṭuruq taɤdilihe.
Šariɤa yiɤaqib ɤala killu taɤadilihe maahu šarɤi wo eyi tadnis lisivaat əljumḥuuriyye.
Maada 31 : Lugaat woṭoniyye hiyye lugaat rasmiiyye li Mali.
Šariɤa ɤuḍwiyye yihadid šuruut wo turuq taɤdiilihim.
Luga faransiyya hiya luga šagal.
əddowla yimkin ɤan taɤtamid eyi luga saani keluga šagal.
Maada 32 : Laa-ikiyya laa tuɤariḍ əddiin wol muɤtaqadaat. Niyyat-he hiye taṭwiir wo taqwiya li ɤayš maɤan ɤala ăsaas tasaamah wo tawanasə wo tavaḥam əlmutbaadila.
Dowla taḍman ihtiraam keemil adiyaan wo muɤtaqidaat wo huriyya mumaarasa ibaada bi ihtiraam əšdariɤa.
Maada 33 : əljumhuriyya əl-ijtimaaɤiyya tagum ɤala mabaadiɤ taḍaami wo musaawa wol ɤadaala wo himaaya wo indimaaj. Dowla tataxiz taɤdiilaat waajiba liḍomaan ḍirhe.
Maada 34 : Šagl ɤaam yistaršid bi mabaadii. Tagum ɤala ihtiraam siyaada dowla wo xiyaaraat šaɤab siyaadiiya wo difaaɤ ɤan maṣlaha.

Maada 35 : Sulṭa ɤaama maa yimkin li ey, tahta ṭaaɤila əl-ɤuquubaat, ḍir sulṭaat illi tatamataɤ bihe bi muujib Dustuur u šariɤa li ixtilaas mawaarid ɤaama u mumtalakaat li maṣlahatihe əlxaasa u liman vaɤa man hum vi sulṭa, u rawaagij ɤaa-ilat-him u munaẓimaat-him u insaan saanin ɤan ṭoriig əlmahsuubiyye u əlfasaad u ixtilaas u istiglaal u nuvuuz u maahu ʑalika min wasaa-il.
Maada 36 : Muɤasasaat əljumḥuriyya hiye :
Majlis ixtiṣaadi wo ijtimaɤi wo bi-i wo ʂaqafi.
Maada 37 : Siyaada woṭoniyya milk li šaɤb illi yiḍirhe min xilaal mumaʂilin muntaxibiin bi ixtiraaɤi ɤam mubaašara u maahu mubaašara u ɤan ṭariiq istiftaa-i.
Ma yimkin li ey jiz-i min šaɤb, wo la li ey raagij ɤan yiɤayid ḍirhe.
Maada 38 : Ihtiraaɤ ɤaam hag wo mutasaawi wo sirri. Yimkin u an takuuna mubaašara u maahu mubaašara.
Naxibuun, bimuujib šuruut illi yihadid-ḥe šariɤa, mwaatin Maaliyuun min qila jinseyn vi sinni ixtiraaɤi wo yitmataɤuun bihuquuq-him madaniyya wo siyaasiyye.
Maada 39 : Ahzaab siyaasiyya tuḍir vi taɤbir ɤan hag iqtiraaɤi. Yitim tašqiiluhum wo yiḍiruun ɤanšiṭothim bihuriyya wo ihtiraam šuruuṭ illi yihadid-he əššariiɤa.
Wo ɤaleyhum ihtiraam mabaadi siyaada əlwotoniyya wo diimokraṭiyye wo silmi turaab woṭoniyya wo laa-ikiyya dowla.
Maada 40 : ¨Munazamaat mujtamaɤ madani tuḍir, vi iṭaar diimukraṭiyya tašaarikiiya, muḥima muraaqaba mwaaṭini wo ihtiraam šuruuṭ illi yihadid-he əššariɤa.
Maada 41 : Dowla maḥam-he siyaada tiḍir ɤala keemil turaabil woṭoni.
Dowla maa yimkin ɤan talge ey jaz-ɤi min raaḍi əlwoṭoniiye, wo laa tunaʑil ɤan ey min huquug siyaadiyya illi yiḍir ɤaleyhi.
Killu iɤitidaa-i ɤala wuhda turaab əlwoṭoni jariima ḍida ămn dowla.
Maada 42 : Lidowla huquug siyaadiya ɤala ʂarwaat wo mawaarid ṭobiɤiyye əlwaagiɤa ɤala ăraaḍiḥe.
Yijib ḍiiman istiglal ḥay ʂarawaat wo mawaarid ṭobiɤiya bima yatawaafaq maɤa qawaaɤid himaaya bi-iyya wa liṣoolih ajyaal zark wo mustaqbaliyya.
ƔUNWAAN III : SULṬA TANFIʑIYA
VAṢL I : RA-IS ƏLJUMḤURIYYA

Maada 43 : Ra-is əljumḥuriya huwe ra-is dowla. Huwe haaris Dustuur. Yijasid wuhda woṭoniya. Huwe ḍoomin istiqlaal woṭoni wo silm ăraaḍi wo ihtiraam muɤaaḥadaat wo itifaaqiyaat dowliya. Yisaḥir ɤala maši šagl muntaẓim lisulṭoot ɤaama wo yiḍman istimraariya Dowla.
Maada 44 : Ra-is Jumḥuriya yihadid siyaasa alwoṭon.
Maada 45 : Ra-is Jumḥuriya yintaxab limudda xamsa sanawaat bil-iqtiraaɤi ɤam mubašara. Yihiq lahu iɤaada intixaabu marra waahid bas.
Ma yimkim li ey hal min ahwaal ɤan yixḍima ey raagij yaasir min wilaayatey ke Ra-is li Jumḥuriya.
Maada 46 : Yijib ɤan yakun ey murašah liman ṣab Ra-is Jumḥuriya min aṣli Mali əljinsiya wo ăla yakun ɤindahu jinsiya uxra vi taarix taqdiim tarših.
Yijib ɤan yatamata bi killu huquuqu əlmadaniya wo siyaasiye, wo ɤan yakun andahu xulq zeyn wo nuzaaha.
Yijib ăn la yiqila umruhu ɤan 35 sana wo 75 sana ɤala akʂar vi tarix taqdim tarši wo ɤan yikun qaadiran ɤala mumaarasa əlwaẓifa.
Maada 47 : Yitim intixaabaat Ra-is Jumḥuriya jidiid saabig xamsa wo ărbaɤin yom ɤalal ăqal wo sitiina yoman ɤala axsar saabig frag wilaaya Ra-is zark.
Maada 48 : Yintaxab Ra-is Jumḥuriya bil aglabiya əlmuṭlaqa li ɤadad ăṣwaat.
Iʑa lam yitim wajaat hay vi dowr ulaa, yitim tanẓim dowr ʂani vi yom əl-ăhad ʂaliʂ baɤda iɤlaan nataa-ij dowrlaan nataa-ij dowrlaan nataa-ij dowr ulaa min gibal mahkama dusturiya.

Iʑa maata ahd murašahiin, vi ayam sabɤa saabiq litaarix ixtiraa’ li dowr əl-ula, u wojda nafsu maɤuukan, yimkin lil Mahkama Dusturiya ăn taɤalan ta-ăjiim intixaabaat duun ăn yitajaawaz hay tan yitajaawaz hay tan yitajaawaz hay taăjil xamsata ašara yom.
Dowra ʂaaniya maftuuha lilmurašahay illi huma wujdaa ɤala akbar ɤadad min aṣwaat vi dowr əl-ula mina taṣwit.
Yitim iɤilaan intixaab murašah illi wajda ɤala akbar ɤadad min ăswaat.
Vi halat mowt u insihaaq u ɤabudiya ahad murašahin əlmu-ăhaliin li dowr ʂani, yiẓilu ixtiraa’ maftuuhan ămaama murašah taali hasba tartiib ăṣwaat əlmadlih.
Iʑa maata ăhad muraašaheyn beyn dowrateyn u taɤarqil, yimkin lil Mahkama Dusturiya ăn taɤlin ta-ăjil intixaabaat dun ăn yitɤada hay ta-ăjil xams ta ɤašara yom.
Maada 49 : Muraaqaba intixaab Ra-is Jumḥuriya makfuula min qibal Mahkama Dusturiya illi tafṣil vi šakwa wo taɤlan nataa-ij niḥaa-iyye lil-ixtiraa’.
Maada 50 : Yikamil šariɤa ăhqam mutaɤaliqa bi-ntixaab Ra-is Jumḥuriya.
Maada 51 : La tatawaafaq muhaam Ra-is Jumḥuriya maɤa mumaarasa ey waẓiifa siyaasiya uxra, u ey wilaaya intixaabiya uxra, u ey waẓiifa ɤaama našaaṭ minḥani wo murabah uxra.

Maada 52 : Xilaal fatra wilaayat-ḥi, ma yimkin li Ra-is Jumḥuriya, siwa bi mufradiḥi u min gibla ǝl-aaxarin, hiyaaza u ta-ăjiir ey ši yintami ila klam wilaaya. La yimkin laḥu ǝlmušaaraka, binafsi u biwaasiṭa maahu, fil ɤaquud ɤaama wo xaṣṣa li idaaraat u mu-ăsasaat taabi-ă lidowla u xaadi-ă li seyṭoratǝhe..
Maada 53 : ɤandi manɤi Ra-is Jumḥuriya muɤaqatan min ḍir muḥaam yiɤḍil Ra-is majlis wuzră’i ṣlahiye bišakli mu-ăqit..

Vi haala šigul manṣab Ri-aasa Jumḥuriya li ey sabab min asbaab u bi sabab ɤaa-iq muṭlaq u frag laahazat Mahkama dustuuriya illi yišuv ileyh Ra-is Barleman woṭoni wo Ra-is Majlis šuyuux wo Wazir Lowol inne maḥaam Ra-is Jumḥuriye yiɤaḍil Ra-is Jumḥuriya min gibal Ra-is Barlaman Woṭoniye. Vi hala iɤaaqa u insihaab u mowt hay axir, yitim mumaarasat-hi min gibal Ra-is majlis šuyuux.
Yitim intixab Ra-is Jumḥuriya ǝljdiid baɤda tisɤiin yom ɤalal ăqali wo miyye wo išriin yom ɤalal akbar baɤda taɤkid min šugur u min taabih muṭlaq wol frag lil ɤa-ik.
Ma yimkin ăn takun raagij illi tuwakil ǝlmu-ăkat li Ra-is Jumḥuriya murašaha li intixaabaat almazkuura.
Vi killu haalaat šugur, maa yimkin ăn yiṭobiq badil mawaad 57 wo 60 wo 69 wo 70 wo 184 min hay Dustuur.
Maada 54 : Ra-is lmuntaxib yitwala mahaamu vi frag wilaaye ra-is ṭaari.
Maada 55 : Saabig ăn yibdaɤ woẓifa Ra-is Jumḥuriyet yigsim ămaama Mahkama dustuuriyya ămaama jalsa xaaṣa ǝlgiṣm ăaṭi :

« Agsim billaahi wa lišaɤb Mali mulli siyaada, ikraam wo ḍiman ihtiram Dustuur wo šariɤaat, lihifaaẓ ɤala niẓaam Jumhuri, li ḍir muḥaami bisabab maṣalaha ɤuliyaa lišaɤb, lilhifaaẓ ɤala huquuq insăan wo huriyaat wo injaazaat diimuqraatiya wo mumtalakaat ɤaam, liḍamaat wohda woṭaniyya wo istiglaal woṭon wo silm turaab woṭoni, ɤan taṣriiv vi killu balad ke xaadim muxliṣ li uma wo ăn ubzul killu juhd litahqiig wuhda ifriqiyya.
Vi hal muhaalava hay gazam, ɤan yishab nas ʂikatihim wo axḍoɤ liṣoraama šariɤa ».
Maada 56 : Baɤda muraasim tanziib wo xilal sabɤa ayyaam yisalim Ra-is Jumḥhuriyet tasrih kitaabi bi mumtalakaati ila Ra-is diiwaan muhaasaba. Yixda hay ăxbar li tahdiiʂ ʂanawi wo ande frag manṣab.
Ra-is diiwan muhaaṣaba yigum bi-iblaag ljumḥuur woṭoni bi-istigmaal taɤdiilaat taškiiliya li-axbar wo tawannasaat.
Maada 57 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiɤiin Ra-is lowol wo yifrag maḥaamu.
Yi-iin aɤḍaa-i hukuuma aaxariin baɤda tašaawor maɤ Ra-is lowol wo yifrig maḥaamu.
Maada 58 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yir-ăs Majlis wuzraa. Ra-is lowol yinibǝho bi tafwiiḍ minho wo ɤala jidwal xaṣ.
Maada 59 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiṣdar šariɤaat xilaala xamsa ašara yom taaliya li haala naṣ muɤtamid frag ilal Hukuma.
Vi haala ṭawaali gad yitim taqliiṣ had zamani li-iṣdaar ilaa ʂamaaniya ayyaam.
Yimkim lahe, saabig in-giḍaa-i hay fatra, ɤan yiṭlab biṭalab min barlamaan ḍir mudaawilaat jdiida hawla šariɤa u baɤḍ mawaad.
Ma yimkin rafḍ hay mudaawala jdiida wo taɤliig miḥla zamaniye li-iṣdar.

Maada 60 : Li Ra-is Jumḥuriyya, bi mubaadara minḥe u biqtirah mištariq min girfatin barleman, wora ra-ăyi Mahkama dustuuriyya manšuur vi Jarida rasmiyya, ăn yitra li-istifta-i ey mas-ăla tatɤalag bil maṣlah woṭoniyye, ey mašru šariɤa yitɤalag bi tanẓim sulṭaat ɤaam, u muwaavaga ɤala ittivaaqiyye naqaaba u tafwiiḍ bi taṣdiq ɤala ma-ăahada, wo illi, maahu mutɤaariḍ maɤa dustur, min šaɤnihe ăn tu-ăʂir ɤala šagala mu-ăsasaat.
ɣanda frag istiftaa bi muṣaadaka ɤala šariɤa, Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiṣdur vi ăjaal manṣuuṣ ɤaleyhi vi maada 59.
Maada 61 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yilga, xilaal rubɤu lowol, marra vi sana, saabig ijtimaa’ baraman vi Kongres, klaaman ɤan haala ǝl-uma.

Maada 62 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiwaaṣol maɤa majlis woṭoni wo majlis šuyuux ăn ṭariig rasaa-il illi yiṭlab ăn yiṭluḥe Ra-is jumɤiyya woṭoniyya wo Ra-is Majlis šuyuux. Xaarij dowla, yijtamiɤi majlis woṭoni wo mjlis šuyuux xaṣiiṣan lihay niyya.
Maada 63 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyye huwe Qaa-id ă-ala li quwaat askari musalaha wo ămni . yir-as majlis amni qowmi wolijna difa’ woṭoni .
Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yi-ămur bil jemɤi ɤaama wo yihadid turug mišaaraka mwaatinin vi difaa-i ɤan woṭon ɤinda ma yiqḍi liwaḍɤi ɤani ʑalika.
Maada 64 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya huwe Ra-is majlis quḍaa ăɤale.
Maada 65 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiḍir hag afu. Yixtari šariɤaat afu.
Maada 66 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yiwaqiɤ maraasiin wo qaraaraat ṣaadira ɤan majlis wuzraa’.
Maada 67 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yi-ɤiin ǝlmanaaṣib uliya madaniyya wo askariyya illi yihadid-he šariɤa.
Ǝlmustašar a’ala liṭawaa’iv qowmiyya wo dubaat ɤaamin wo sufara’i wo mab’usin xaaṣin wo hukaam aqaalimi wo mudaraa’i idaaraat markaziye bimujib marsum yittaxiz vi majlis wuzra’i yitimu ta’yiinihumǝ.
Yijib ăn tastanida ta’ayiinaat vi makaam lowol ɤala maɤaayiir ǝlkifaa’a wo xabra wo istiqaama.
Maada 68 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yi’tamid sufaraa’i wo mabɤuuʂin xaaṣin vi Dwal ajnabiyye wo munaẓamaat dowliyye.
Sufaraa’i ajaanib wo Mabɤuuʂu xaaṣa mutamidun ladeyhi.
Maada 69 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yimkin, wora istišaara Ra-isi majlisey wo Ra-is Mahkama Dustuuriyya, axbaar halla jǝmɤiyye woṭoniye.
Ma yikin axbar hal xilal iʂney ašra šaḥran lowal min ḥay-ă tašriɤiyya u ɤindama yiɤlim gubuul iqtiraah bil vaṣl.
Tiḍir intixaabaat ɤama wora sitiin yom ɤala agal wo miyye wo išriin yom ɤala akbar wora halli.
La yimkin halli jdiid vi sana illi tali hay intixaabaat.
ɣanda frag mudda muhadada vi fagra ʂaaliʂa min hay madda, iʑa lam yitim tanẓim intixaabaat tašri’iyye, yiɤaad majlis woṭoni munhali ila waẓaa’ifhe.

Maada 70 : ɣindama tataɤaraḍ mu’ăsasaat Jumḥuriyya, isglaal uma, wo silmi turaab ǝlwoṭoni, wo tanviʑ waajibaat dowliyya litaḥḍiid xaṭir fowri, wo yitwagaf seyri ɤaadi lisulṭaat ɤaama dustuuriyya, ɤala Ra-is Jumḥuriyya yitaxiz taɤḍilaat xaaṣa illi tagdihe hay ẓuruf wora istišaara Ra-is lowol wo Ru-ăsaa-i Jemɤiyya woṭoniye wo majilis šuyuux wo Makama dustuuriyya.
Maa yimkin bi ay hal min ahwal ăn yiḍir taṭbig Ra-is Jumḥuriyya li hay ṣalaahiyaat xaaṣa ila masaas bisiyaada woṭoniyya u silm ɤaraaḍi.
Yijib ăn tahdif sulṭaat xaaṣa ila ḍimaan. Istimraariyya Dowla wo istiɤaada šagl muntaẓim limuɤasasaat, vi agrab waqt mumkin wo ihtiraaman lidustuur.
Aʂnaa’ă mumaarasa sulṭaat xaaṣa, ma yimkin hallu ay mu-ăsasa li Jumḥuriyya u taɤlig-he.
Tadaabir mulli ṭabiiɤa tašriɤiyya mutaxisa aʂna mumaarasa sulṭaat xaaʂa taskut iʑa lam yisaadiq ɤaleyhi ǝlbarleman vi mudda tisɤiin yom min duxulhe hayzǝ tanviiʑ.
Maada 71 : Li Ra-is Jumḥuriyya tafwiiḍ baɤd slaahiyya li Ra-is lowol.

Yitim towqiɤ ɤala šuglaat Ra-is Jumḥuriyya, bi xilaav tilka manṣuuṣ ɤaleyhi vi mawaad 57 wo 60 wo 65 wo 69 wo 70 wo keʑalika fil fagra lowol min hay mada, min gibal Ra-is lowol, wo ɤinda ḍaruura, min gibal wuzraa-i muɤayan.
Maada 72 : Šariɤa yihaddid imtiyaʑaat mamnuuha li Ra-is Jumiḥuriyya wo li Ru-ăsaa-i Jumḥuriyya saadiqin vi tamatiɤ vi huqug madaniyya.
Maada 73 : Yimkin takliif Ra-is Jumḥuriyya bi šuglaat tawaṣif bi xiyaana kbiira.
Yimkin itḥaamu min gibal ǝlbarleman bi tuhma xiyaana kbiira.
ɣindama yixalifu Ra-is Jumḥuriyya gasmu ḥinaake xiyaana kbiira.
Yitimu iqtirah ǝl-azilu min gibal a-ăḍaa-i ey min majlis ǝlbarleman. Ma yimkin gabulu ila iʑa tamma tawqiɤ aleyhi min gibal ma laa yigil ɤan ʂuluʂey a-ăḍaa-i.
Tuhil algurfa әlmuɤayana bil amr ila lijne xasa illi tatawale dir kemil tahqiigaat wo jilsaat listima’ɤi laazim, wora zalika takarara muwaasala ta’adilaat min adami.
Iza qararat lijne innehe maa tuhjid ahwaaj li muhaakema, yitimmu frag ta’adiilaat vasl.
Iza qararat lijne anna hunaake sabab lilmuqaada, wa innehe tudir laa’iha itḥam muɤalala illi tu’arad ɤala majlis litaswiit bi yaasir әlbasita li aadaa’i.

Iza tama tibni laa’iha ithaam, yitim šuv ila gurfa uxra vi mudda ʂamaaniya ayaam wo yijib an tasdar ahkaaman mutataabaka vi mudda xamsata ašra yom. Iza lam yitim i’itimaad laa’iha it’haam, yitim frag ta’adilaat azli.
Yit ratib ɤala qaraar it’ḥam min gibal majlis, bihukm šariɤa, rafɤi killu hasaana Ra-is Jumḥuriyya.
Yijtamiɤ majlisey әlbarleman vi Kongres әlxas libti vi igaala Ra-is Jumḥuriyya.
Yisdar әlvaṣl bi axbar min ʂalaaʂa arbaaɤi li aɤadaa’i.
Yitim ihtisaab aṣwaat muɤayida li vaṣl bas.
Jilsaat Kongres әlxas Ra-is Mahkama ɤuliye.
Li Ra-is Jumḥuriyya hag difaaɤi. yimkin an yisaa’idu mahaami min ixtiyaarihi vi killu maraahil ta’adilaat.
Qaanun ɤudwiiye yihadid keyviyaat tatbiig hay maada.
Maada 74 : Ra-is Jumḥuriyya mas’ul jinaa’iyan amaama mahaakin šariɤa ɤam, ɤani jiraa’im wo jinahi murtakaba xarij mumarasa muhaam waziifa.
Maɤa zalika, maa yimkin an yit’lab minhu šihaada, u an yikuna mawdu’u amal, u viɤl ixbaari, u ta’alimaat, u muhaakama hate frag wilaayat’hi.
Yitim ta’alig ey fatra taqyiid u habs yimkin isti’naaf kadaaya wo ta’diilaat illi ti’arkil u tahariiq’he diddu wura šaḥar wahid min frag mahaamu.
Maada 75 : Tit’alav hukuuma min Ra-is Lowol wo huwe Ra-is әlhukuuma wo wuzra’i. Yi yihadid šariɤa asaasi ɤadad aɤdaa’i hukuuma.
Maada 76 : Tadbir әlhukuuma siyaasa umma illi yihadid he Ra-is Jumḥuriyya. Yitṣaraf vi idaara.
Maada 77 : Ra-is lowol huwe Ra-is Hukuuma.
ɣala hay nahwi, vә innehe yiwejih šagl hukuum.
Yidman tanviiz šariɤa. Maɤa muraat ahkaam maadatey 66 wo 67, yidir sulta rakaabiyya.
Yimkin tafwiid baɤd slaahiyyat li wuzraa’i.
Yinib mahal Ra-is Jumḥuriyya vi ri’aasa Majlis wuzraa bitafwiid wo li jdwal a’amaal muhadad.
Yinib m’hallu vi ri’asa Majlis ɤam qom wo Lijna difaa’i wotoni.
Yitim towqi’ɤ ɤala šaglaat Ra-is lowol, iʑa lazima amr, min gibal wuzraa’i muwakaliin bi tanviiʑәhe.
Maada 78 : Hukuuma mas’ul amaama Ra-is Jumḥuuriya.
Maada 79 : Yigadim aɤdaa’i hukuuma ila Ra-is Diiwaan mahasaba iqraar xatban bi mumtalaqaat-hum xilaala mudda aqṣaahe ʂalaaʂun yom wora ta’ayiin him.
Ra-is diiwaan mahaasaba yigum bi axbar jumḥur wotoni bi istigmaal ta’adiilaat šaqliiya li axbar wo tawannasaat.
Tasirri ahkaam maada 52 ɤalaa a’adaa’i Hukuuma.

Maada 80 : Ra-is lowol ya’arid xutta šaglә әl-Hukuuma amaama әlbarleman. Yitim tagdiim amaama killu minal majilisey ʂalaaʂun yom ɤala akbar wora klam Ra-is Jumḥuriyye ɤan haala Woton. Wo talihe, ɤande iqtidaa’i munaakašaati maṣhuuba bi towsiyaat bi dun taswiit.

Maada 81 : Laa tatwaafag wazaa’if ɤudwi Hukuuma maɤa mumaarasa ey tafwiid barlemaani, u ey waẓifa min waẓaa’if tamʂil mihani ɤala mustawe wotoni u mahali, u ey waẓifa ɤaama u ey našaat miḥani murabah.
Maada 82 : Aɤadaaj’i Hukuuma mas’uulin jnaa’iyan ɤan jәraa’im u jәnaahi illi tartakib ɤanda dir wazaa’if hum.
Dir wo tahqiig min ixtiṣaaṣ Mahkama ɤulye. Ǝlhukm huwe min ixtiṣaaṣ mahaakim jәnaa’iye ɤaadiiye.
Tasri ahkaam šariiɤa taɤdiilaat jәnaa’iye lilmuqaada’ wo tahqiig wo hukm.
Maada 83 : Idaara tagum, bi aškaal muxtalif, bi muhaam nafɤi ɤam illi biniyat min sebeb he xidmaat.

Maada 84 : Idaara tәšaarik vi tatwiir talmiye iqtiṣaadiyye wo ijtimaa’iye wo ʂabafiyye min xilal istijaab bi tarig munaasaba li ihtiyaajaat mustamaɤ wotoni wo mustaxdimi, bišafaaviyye wo ihtiraam huquuq Insan wo dimuqrati.
Maada 85 : Wuk’la idaara yiltazim vi mumaarat’hum li muḥaami hum bih’tiraam mabaadi asaasiyye lixidma aama bima vi zalika šar iyya wo musaa waati wo hiyaat wo istimraariyya.
Yijib an yit banu suluukan yahtarim qawaa’id axlaaq wo ilm axlaaq, ɤala wijhi xuṣuuṣ, niẓaaḥa wo istigaama aklaabiyya.

Maada 86 : Dowla tahriʂ ɤala idraaj towẓiif muwaẓafi xidma madanihyya vi itor ta’adiilaat šavaava tidman takaafu’ vurṣa likeemil wo tirkiiz tetwiir hayaat’him әlmihaniyye ɤala maɤaayiir kefaa’a wo miheniyye.
Maada 87 :Dowla taharis ɤala an tiwara a’ɤawaan idaara šuruut šagal wo mukaafa’aat wo amn waajib lizeyn dir muhaamihum.
VAṢL IV : SULTAAT IDAARIYA ƎLMUSTAQILA
Maada 88 : Sultaat idaariya әlmustaqila tudir mahaamahe, xaaṣatan vi majaalaat wasaata wo tanẓiim wo tahqiiq wo riqaaba wo himaaya huquuq huriyaat wo fardiiye wo tanẓiim intixaabaat wo idaarat’he.
Yitim inšaa’i sultaati idaariya mustaqila bi muujib šariɤa.
VAṢL V : QUWAAT ƎLMUSALAHA WOL AMN
Maada 89 : Quwaat musalaha wol amn muwakala bi difaa’i ɤan silm turaab woton wo himaaya rawaagij wo mumtalakaat-hum wo hifaaz ɤala niẓaam ɤam wo tanfiiẓ šariɤaat.
Yišaarikuun šglaat tatwiir iqtiṣaadiyya wo ijtimaa’iyya wo ʂaqaafiyya wo himaaya bii-a vi blaad.
Maada 90 : Quwaat musalaha wo amn vi xidma uma. Hum jmhuuriyun wo maahu siyaasiyuun wo xaadi’un lisultat siyaasiyya.
Maada 91 : Ma yimkin istiqdaam quwaat musalaha illa li hifaaẓ ɤala niẓaam ɤam wo ihtiraaman li šuruut illi yihadidḥe šariɤa.
Maada 92 : Yimkin liquawaati musalaha wo amn mišaaraka vi mahaam silm u istiqraar u amn xaarijiiye vi itor imtiʂal iltizaamaati Mali әddowliiya.

Maada 93 : Dowla tuwakil an tatwafar li Quwaat musalaha wo amn vi killu awgaat imkeeniyya mawaarid bašariyya wo wasaa’il maadiyye laazima li injaaz muḥaamihe. Yitim taxtiit hay mawaarid wo wasaa’il min xilaal šariɤaat әlmuxatata.
ƔUNWAAN IV : SULTAT TAŠRIIYYE
VAṢL I : AHKAAM ƔAAM
Maada 94 : Sulṭa tašrikiɤiyya yiḍirḥe әlBarleman.
Yikir әlBarleman šariɤa wo yiɤaḍilhum fi taqyim siyaasaat ɤaama.
Maada 95 : Yit’alaf әlBarleman min majliseyn : Majlis әlwoṭoni wo majlis šuyuux.
ӘlKongres ḥuwe ijtimaɤ daareyn әlBarleman. Yitwala ri-aasa әl-Congres min Ra-is jәmɤiyya әwoṭoniyya wo na’ib Ra-is min gibal Ra-is Majlis šuyuux.
Maada 96 : ăɤḍaa’i Jәmɤiyya woṭoniyya yiɤmilun u yangalun lagab na’ib.
Yintaxib nuwab limuda xamsa sanawaat bil iqtira’i ɤam mubašar. Yimkin ăn yakn niswiit biyaasir, nasabiyan u mixṭalan.
Yitim tamʂil Maaliyiin illi ḥum yiɤišun vil xarij Jәmɤiya woṭoniya ihtiraan taɤdilaat illi yiḥadid-he šariɤa.
Maada 97 : Aɤḍaa’ Majlis šuyuux lagab šuyuux.

Majlis šuyuux, li ʂalaaʂa ărbaɤi min aɤḍaa’i muntaxibiin bi-iqtiraa’i ɤam ma mubaašara yimaʂilun sulṭaat mahaliyya, wo limuda rubɤi aɤdaa’i muɤyaniina yumaʂilun sulṭaat wo šarɤiyaat әtaqlidiyya, wo Maliyiin muqimiina vi xaarij wo rawaagij kerama xidma woṭoniyya.
Mudda ɤudwiiya aɤdaa’i Majlis šuyuux xamsa sanawaat.
Maada 98 : Ma yimkin li ḥad ăn yikn ɤudwan vi killu Jәmɤiyya woṭoniyya wo Majlis šuyuux.
Maada 99 : šariɤa yihadid haalaat intixaab nuwaab Majlis wotoniye kivi. Tihadid torob intixaab aɤdoo’i majlis šuyuux u taɤyiin-hum.

Maada 100 : šariɤa yihadid ɤudwiyya, likillu min majliseyni, added aɤaḍaa-i, šurut aḥliya wo lizaam maa hu aḥliiya wo maa hu towfiig. Kivi yiɤadid šuruut illi bi muɤjibhe yitim isbdaal humә vi hal wujud šaagir.
Maada 101 : šariɤa yihidid ɤudwiyya әlbadalaat wol mazayaa’ uxre әlxaaso linuwaab wo ɤadaaɤi Majlis šuyuux.
Maada 102 : Wora taxyiir-hum rasmiiyan wo xilaal ʂalaaʂiin yom yit-salim Ra-is Diiwaan muhaasaba qaraaraat kitbiyye bi mumtolaqaat nuwaab wo aɤdaa’i Majlis šiyuux.
Taxdiɤi hay axbar li tawaanasaat ʂanawiiye wo ɤanda frag manṣab.
Ra-is Diiwaan muhaasaba yixbir jәmḥur әlwotoni bi-istgmal taɤdiilaat taškiiliyye li axbar wo tawanasaat.

Maada 103 : Nuwaab wo aɤdaa’i majlis šuyuux wolida istivaada min hasaana әlbarlemaniyya bas vi itor dir wo zoo’if-hum. Maa yimkin mulaahakatḥum u tahkiig maɤaḥum u towqiivḥum u mahaakamatḥum bisabab araa’i u aswaad illi yitim taɤbir anhe xilaal jilsaat әlbarlemaniyya.

Maada 104 : Killu naa’ib u šayx yisqut udwiiya bi hukm jәnaa’i niḥaa’i binaa’i ɤala tolab wazir muwakel bil adl. Wo yintobiq ši navṣ ɤandema yihkam ɤala naa’ib u šayx bi uquuba iṣlaa’iyya niḥaa’iyya tusaawi u tazyaad ɤan sana waahid min sijn maa hu waqf an šagl.
Maada 105 : Ey tafwiid hatmi baatil.
Hag taṣwiid aɤdaa’i әl-Barleman raagijii. šariiɤa asaasiya yimkin an yi’azin bi šakl xaaṣ bi tafwiid taṣwiid. Vi hay haala, maa yimkin li had an yid ɤala tawfiid akbar min wilaaya waahida.
Maada 106 : Killu naa’ib u šayx illi yihram min hizbih siyaasi u min tanzim illi yimaʂilu yihram min wilaayat-hi.
Әl-istiqaala yitim tasjiil kitaaba. Yiɤtabar indimaam ilaa hizb u munazama uxra istiqaala.
Yitim istibdaal naa’ib u šayx bišurut illi yihadid-he šariiɤa asaasiyye.
VAṢL II : ŠAGL ƎLBARLEMAN
Maada 107: Jәmɤiyya wotoniye wo әl-Majlis šuyuux yitami’aani, min hag vi dowrateyn ɤaadiyateyn vi sana.
Tibdaɤ jilsa lowol vi awal yom šagl yom iʂneyn vi šaḥr oktober. Maa yimkin an yitjaawaz xamsa wo sabɤin yom.
Tibdaɤ jilsa ʂaaniya vi vi awal yom šagl yom iʂneyn min ayaam šagl vi šaḥr avril. Wo maa yimkin an titjaawaz tisɤiin yom.
Maada 108 : yijtamiɤ majlis nuwaab vi dowra xaaṣ, ima min bi tolab min Ra-is Jәmḥuriyya u ɤala tolab min yaasir aɤdaa’i Majlis wotoni u Majlis šuyuux, ɤala jәdwal ɤa’amaal muhadada.
Vi hala igaad dowra xaaṣ, yasri marsum iglaq bi mujarad istinfaad majlis nuwaab jәdwal ɤa’amaal illi in-agad bi sabab-hi, wo ʑalika vi waqt akbar ɤan xams ta ɤara yom min tarix di-aayatihi.
Maada 109 : Vi ma adar haalaat illi yitwale vihe әl-Barleman yijtamiɤ hukman, wo taftah dowraat xaaṣ wo taxtatim bi marsum min Ra-is әl-jәmḥuriyya.
Maada 110 : Naa’ib u šayx yiltazim bi mušaaraka vi šәglaat lijaan wo jilsaat ɤaam, tahta taa-ila ɤaquubaat manṣuuṣ ɤaleyhe vi lawaa-iḥi daaxiliyya li jәmɤiyya wotoniyya wo Majlis šuyuux.
Maada 111 : Yidir killu min gurfatey әl-Barleman anzimatuhu әddaaxiliyya. Yitimu dir nizaam daaxili lil Kongres min gibal gurfateyn.
Maada 112 : Ra-is jәmɤiyya wotoniyya wo Ra-is Majlis šuyuux yitimu intixaabu huma limuda majlis tašriɤiy.
Maada 113 : Ra-is jәmɤiyya wotoniyya wo Ra-is Majlis šuyuux yimkin an yixdo’ɤa taɤdiilaat azli bisabab ɤadam dir waajibaat manṣib huma.
Li key takn magbula, yijib an yidir tawqiɤ ɤala mubaadara vaṣl min gibal maa laa yagille an ʂuleʂey aɤdaa’i majlis muɤyan.
Maa yimkin šariiɤa vi taɤdiil vaṣl vi awol sanateyn wora tuwaliya manṣab ra’is Jәmɤiyya wotoniyya u Majilis šuyuux.
Yiṣdar vaṣl bi yaasir ʂalaaʂa arbaaɤi aɤdaa’i majlis mu-ayanna bi šuruut illi yi-adid-he niẓaam daaxili.
Vi haala iqaala, tašarɤa Jәmɤiyya wotoniyya u Majlis šuyuux vi intixaab Ra-is jәdiid wo ihtiraaman lišuruut illi tuhadid he qawaa’id taɤdiiliiya. Yikemil Ra-is jәdiid wilaaya Ra-is maxluuɤ.
Maada 114 : Jilsaat Majlis Barleman ɤam. Wo maɤ ʑalika, yimkin li kullu gurfa juluus vi sirr mugalaqa bi mubaadara minhe ɤala tolab hukuuma.
Niẓaam daaxili yihadid taraa’iq. Tamma našru taqrir keemil li munaaqašaat bi luga jariida rasmiyye.
VAṢL III : MAJAAL ŠARIƔA WO ANẒIMA
Maada 115 : Šariiɤa yiqarir min gibal әl-Barleman an yaasir basiito.
Әl-umur illi asnada-he iley-hi ṣaraaḥa mawaad uxra min Dustuur hiye min ixtiṣaaṣ šariiɤa :
Huquuq madaniyya wo domaanaat asasiyya mamnuuha li mwaatiniin li dir huriyaat ɤaama ;
Quyuud illi yifrad-he Difaa’ɤ Wotoni ɤala mwaatiniin vi anfus-him wo mumtalakaat-hum ;

әl-jinsiyya wo huquuq madaniyya wo wodɤ naas wo ahliyat-hum wo anẓima taqayyam wo haala rigaaj wo woriʂaat wo karima wo niẓaam milkiyye wo huquuq haqiiqa wo iltizamaat madaniyya wo tijaariyya wo niẓaam šarikaat, wo nazɤi milkiyya ;

әl-jaraa’im wo jәnahq wo ɤuquubaat mutabaqa ɤaleyhe, taɤdiilaat jinaa’iyya, wo šurtot әlqadoo’iy, wo taslim mujrimiin wo afu, wo tašqil mahaakim, wo haala dubaat wuzra’, wo haala miḥan šariiɤa wo qadoo’iyya ;
haala ɤam li muwaaẓafi xidma madaniyye ;
haala ɤam li afraad Quwaad muṣalaha wo amn ;
haala muɤalimiin-baahiʂiin vi taɤliim ɤali wo bahʂ ilmi ;
haala ɤam li tolabaat mihaniiya ;
niẓaam әl-umla wo qaa’ɤidat-he wo siɤir-he wo turug tahṣil doraa’ib ;
tanẓiim ɤam bi difaaɤ wo amn ;
šariiɤa šagl wo dimaan ijtimaaɤi wo šariiɤa naqabaat ;
